9000666.en: {name|A}, I've lost so much of my energy. I'll tell you the last spell, and you cast it for me... the order is A1, f6, Tongren, Dayou...
9000666.ch: {name|A}，我灵力消耗极大，这最后一道阵法，你来替我操作，顺序是甲一，巳六，同人，大有……

9000667.en: There is a strange ring-shaped lock with various symbols near the array. You touch it, and it is lit up in several directions.
9000667.ch: 阵法旁边有一个篆刻天干地支六十四卦的奇特锁环，稍一碰触之后，数个方位顿时点亮。

9000671.en: You triggered the wrong directions, and the lock has reset...
9000671.ch: 你触发了错误方位，锁环重新复位……

9000672.en: How did Gu Yuan'er open the lock then?
9000672.ch: 当时顾鸢儿是怎么触发锁环的呢？

9000675.en: I'm going to see the Master now to seek permission to transfer Alliance Guards. Please hurry to the Altar to help Yuan'er. I'll catch up with you as soon as I can!
9000675.ch: 我这便去请盟主给我调动仙卫的权力。请道友先行火速前往祈天台拯救鸢儿。我随后即到！

9000676.en: I never knew Yuan'er could be so agitated...
9000676.ch: 不承想，鸢儿竟如此激动……

9000679.en: You come out of the portal and hurry to the Altar. It is surrounded by monsters, which are struck by lightning bolts falling from the top of the Altar.
9000679.ch: 你从传送阵出来后赶到祈天台前。只见附近都是妖兽围困，高台之上发出一道道电光轰击下方妖兽。

9000680.en: After some of the monsters at the foot of the Altar have been killed, the entrance to the Altar is gradually opened.
9000680.ch: 高台下面部分妖兽被雷击消灭后，面前高台入口随即缓缓洞开。

9000682.en: In the Recluse's Room are futons and beds. It must be a cultivation room for the cultivators stationed in the Altar before. It is empty now.
9000682.ch: 云房之中陈列蒲团坐床，想是昔日入驻祈天台修仙者专心修炼的地方。不过眼前空无一人。

9000683.en: In the Storeroom are many elixirs you can't name. It is empty now.
9000683.ch: 饵阁之中仍有大量不知名丹药，却是空无一人。

9000684.en: In the Library stand many bookshelves, on which many books are rotten. Some books have fallen onto the floor, leaving the whole room in a mess. There is no trace of Gu Yuan'er here.
9000684.ch: 编纬阁中陈列大量书柜，上面许多书籍都已朽坏，部分散落地上，让阁中显得十分凌乱。不过此处亦未发现顾鸢儿踪迹。

9000685.en: You walk into the Multipurpose Room and find Gu Yuan'er sitting before the desk, reading a thick tome.
9000685.ch: 进入器用无穷室中，只见顾鸢儿埋首案前，正在翻阅一本厚厚的书籍。

9000686.en: It...It's dangerous here. Why are you here?
9000686.ch: 这……这里很危险，你怎么来了？

9000687.en: ...Master has decided to demolish the Altar, and Aunt Luo can't stop him. I can't stand by and see my father's works destroyed with it... Look! I have found my father's work! Chi You Anecdotes!
9000687.ch: ……盟主已经决定要拆毁祈天台，骆姑姑再怎么争取也没用了。我不能让爹爹的留下的著作也被毁去……你看我这不是找到了么？《赤幽别志》！

9000688.en: There must be something I can do. This Altar is under the protection of many spells, and many of them are recorded in my father's book... It's the Day of Clear Sky today, which means the spells in the Altar can be effective to the full. Let's activate them to repel the besieging monsters.
9000688.ch: 一定有办法的，这座高台拥有无数禁咒符法，爹爹的书中亦有很多记述。有了……今日是天清日，祈天台的禁咒威力可以有效发挥，我们到高台上发动符法击退围攻妖兽。

9000689.en: Gu Yuan'er runs toward the top of the Altar, but as she opens the door, she hears a roar from above. A monster appears out of nowhere, leaving Gu Yuan'er completely dumbfounded...
9000689.ch: 顾鸢儿说着飞奔到祈天台顶，然而刚打开门，台顶立即发出一阵巨响，一只妖兽不知从何处跑到祈天台顶。顾鸢儿一见之下，顿时花容失色……

9000690.en: How...did Taowu...come up here? How did it get inside?
9000690.ch: 这……梼、梼杌凶兽……怎么会？怎么进来的？

9000691.en: Activate the spells! I'll hold it off!

9000692.en: You have defeated Taowu, but its mouth gapes and spurts out a lot of Nether Air, shrouding the Altar in darkness. The monsters nearby seem to be invigorated by the Nether Air and start charging at the Altar.
9000692.ch: 你战胜凶兽，却不想梼杌突然张开大口，喷出大量冥气，祈天台上顿时黑雾笼罩。附近妖兽仿佛受到冥气召唤驱使，纷纷猛冲祈天台。

9000693.en: According to my father's book, a monster with Nether Air Condensation can't be defeated with ordinary means... We must run...
9000693.ch: 爹爹记载妖兽若将冥气凝结成晶体之状，则非寻常手段可以击杀……眼前梼杌已养成冥气结晶，打不过的……我们逃吧……

9000694.en: Suddenly, a lot of flying swords appear from the distance, thrusting into the monster formation. At the same time, Luo Ying and Alliance Guards have arrived and start engaging the monsters.
9000694.ch: 此时远方天空出现大量飞剑，一支支劲射而来，将台下妖兽阵势打乱，与此同时，骆瑛带着仙卫御剑而来，瞬间杀入兽群，与之恶战。

9000695.en: Yuan'er, we'll go up there after defeating the monsters. My friend, please hold out for a little longer...
9000695.ch: 鸢儿，我们马上杀退妖兽登台救你！道友，请务必再支持一会……

9000696.en: Just as Luo Ying finishes her words, a spear of light falls from the sky through the Nether Air and pierces Taowu's belly. A female voice is heard. "Taowu's Nether Condensation has been shattered by my Scarlet Sun Arrow. Defeat it now and leave the Altar."
9000696.ch: 骆瑛语声才落，一支光矛从天而降，辟开冥气插中梼杌腹心。一个女性声音同时响起：此兽冥晶核心暂时为我赤阳箭所破，快趁现在击败梼杌，逃下台去。

9000697.en: You defeat Taowu again and take Gu Yuan'er out of the Altar, where Luo Ying is waiting for you. Gu Yuan'er wants to throw herself into Luo Ying's arms, but Luo Ying gives her a loud slap in her face...
9000697.ch: 你再次将梼杌击败，并护着顾鸢儿急速逃下台去。刚到台下，骆瑛已在等候。顾鸢儿乍见骆瑛，竟一下扑了过去，想投入骆瑛怀抱。不过骆瑛抬手一挥，啪的一下打了顾鸢儿一个耳光……

9000699.en: You... for you, Alliance Guards are risking everything!
9000699.ch: 为了你这家伙，劳师动众，竟将众多仙卫陷在危机之中！

9000700.en: Elder, Taowu hasn't been put down yet. It's still spurting out a lot of Nether Air. What should we do now?
9000700.ch: 禀告长老，梼杌仍未被消灭，现正喷出大量冥气。我们是撤是战，请长老主张！

9000701.en: Now that it only has the last breath, and I've promised to Master to destroy the Heaven Sacrifice Altar, how can we let it go and threaten our Alliance again?
9000701.ch: 凶兽既已经奄奄一息，我又向盟主承诺毁去祈天台，岂能放任它活着成为我仙盟来日劲敌？

9000702.ch: 可……可是，此妖似乎杀之不死……

9000703.en: According to my father's book, it must be the Nether Air devouring the monster's soul that revived Taowu twice... The Nether Air is only effective in Taowu's body, so we can kill it after we smash it to ashes.
9000703.ch: 根据爹爹记载，梼杌两度复活，该是冥气侵吞凶兽魂魄，导致其再次苏醒……冥气赖于梼杌实体才能活动，我们将梼杌打成齑粉即能将之杀死。

9000705.en: We can activate the spells in the opposite direction to destroy the columns in the Altar. After the Altar is shattered, its every fragment is still empowered by the spells, and they will destroy Taowu's body... This is my father's assumption, and it has never been put into practice. If it works...the Altar will also be destroyed.
9000705.ch: 逆向发动禁咒，摧毁祈天台内梁柱，祈天台粉碎后，每颗碎片附着禁咒威力，当可摧毁梼杌肉身……这是爹爹设想，未曾验证。假如能成……祈天台也就一并毁了。

9000706.en: Yuan'er, you always complained I didn't let you outside the Alliance to carry out missions. Today I'll make an exception. I'll leave it to you to destroy the Altar and kill Taowu with the spells.
9000706.ch: 鸢儿，你向来怨我不允许你离开仙盟执行任务。今日老身破例一回，眼前梼杌由你摧毁祈天台以禁咒将之杀死。

9000708.en: Gu Yuan'er activates the spells in the Altar, bringing it down in an instant. The falling rubbles transform into golden beams that pierce Taowu, blasting it to ashes. However, the Nether Air within it is discharged and rushes toward the Alliance.
9000708.ch: 顾鸢儿发动祈天台中暗藏禁咒后高台轰然倒下，落石瓦砾半空之中化为道道金光，穿透梼杌。梼杌瞬间爆裂化为齑粉，但同时梼杌体内积蓄的冥气汹涌泄出，直奔仙盟而去。

9000709.en: How did you get into a clash with such a ferocious beast? Such overwhelming Nether Air.
9000709.ch: 怎么就惹到这等凶兽了？冥气竟如此厉害。

9000710.en: Sunny waves her hand and the Nether Air around her dissipates in an instant.
9000710.ch: 圣阳随手拨弄，她身边冥气瞬间散去。

9000711.en: You! You are... an Immortal Bird?

9000713.en: I, Cultivator Alliance Elder Luo Ying, beseech you, Lady Immortal Bird, to help us remove the Nether Air from our Alliance!
9000713.ch: 老身仙盟长老骆瑛，恳请仙鸟娘娘出手散去即将侵袭我仙盟的冥气！

9000714.en: And you? What do you think?

9000715.en: Fine. You and Hou Yi once retrieved my ten scattered souls and helped me reunite as one. I owe you my life. I'll help you this time.
9000715.ch: 好，昔日我十个元神分离，你与后羿将之收复使我得以重新凝聚，总算对我有恩，我就再帮你一把。

9000716.en: Sunny takes to the sky and waves her sleeves, summoning the sunlight to pierce the Nether Air toward the Alliance city. The Nether Air surging toward the wall is halted and dissipates instantly.
9000716.ch: 圣阳说完，脚下一点，轻飘飘飞上半空。她袖子招了两招，天上阳光穿破冥气，照住仙盟主城，朝城墙涌去的冥气瞬间遏止，眨眼间完全散去。

9000717.en: Thank you for saving our Alliance, Lady Immortal Bird.
9000717.ch: 感谢仙鸟娘娘施展手段，救我仙盟于水火之中。

9000719.en: My friend, you have done so much for our Alliance, and our Master has always been eager to meet you. Now that it has settled, why don't you go back to the Alliance to meet him? Ah... He is a person of insight. You should be careful with your behavior and words before him. Yuan'er, take our guest to the Master, and then come to find me. I want to have a word with you.
9000719.ch: 对了，道友，你为仙盟出过不少力气，盟主早就想见见你了。眼前大事已了，这便回去仙盟面见盟主如何？唔……盟主长于洞悉人心，道友须记得谨言慎行。鸢儿，你带道友去找盟主，之后还来我处，我有话说。

9000721.en: I caused such big trouble, and I envied you for winning Aunt Luo's favor, but you still came to save me. I'm really sorry. And thank you for saving me!
9000721.ch: 之前都是我任性导致酿出这么大的事情来，还因为姑姑看重你，对你心生不满，最后却让你冒险前来救我，真的很对不起。还有，谢谢！

9000722.en: This is something I collect from the Heaven Sacrifice Altar, which is said to have mysterious effects. Please keep it... Master is waiting over there. He will surely entrust you with more important missions after hearing your achievements.
9000722.ch: 这是我在祈天台取得的一点小玩意，据说颇有神效，给你留着玩吧……盟主就在前面等候，你过去吧。想来盟主知道你的事迹定要对你多加重用。

9000723.en: My friend, I've heard about your great contribution to the Alliance after joining us for only a short period of time. And now you played a vital role in killing Taowu. But as the last line of defense for all the cultivators, our Alliance has far more demanding duties to fulfill.
9000723.ch: 道友，听说你来我仙盟不久已经为仙盟出了不少力气，就刚才还击杀梼杌凶兽。但仙盟作为修仙者的最终防线，要做的远远不是这些。

9000724.en: We suffered a devastating defeat a hundred years ago and were forced to retreat behind the new line of defense. We will need your help desperately in our future efforts to repel the Wave of Monsters and further explore the depths of Chi You.
9000724.ch: 我仙盟百年前遭受重创，防线后撤，今后击退兽潮，进一步探索赤幽州深处，正是迫在眉睫的大事。诸事还需仰仗道友臂助。

9000725.en: Jiuying is commanding the Wave of Monsters to assault our line of defense. It's the biggest threat to our Alliance. Since you have killed so many monsters, I hope you could join hands with us to kill Jiuying.
9000725.ch: 九婴主持兽潮，冲击防线，是眼前我仙盟的腹心之患。道友几次击杀妖兽，实力出类拔萃，因此本座希望道友从此与我们一起对抗兽潮，击杀九婴。

9000726.en: The survival of the world depends on this mission. We must kill it at all costs.
9000726.ch: 道友，此事关乎我八荒命运，无论如何亦要击杀此妖。

9000727.en: A strange howl is heard in the distance. Master points his finger toward it, and you see the silhouette of a nine-headed monster in the dense Nether Air.
9000727.ch: 此时远方一声奇特叫声发出遍传大地。盟主抬手一指，远处冥气浓重之处，果然隐约有一九头妖物向天啸叫。

9000728.en: With that word spoken, Sunny leaves in low spirits.
9000728.ch: 圣阳说完，失魂落魄的离开了。

9000730.en: Luo Ying implored me many times, and it's hard for me to refuse her again. Besides, you are in the Cultivator Alliance now. I owed you one.
9000730.ch: 骆瑛几番请托，我颇有点盛情难却。再说，既然你也加入到仙盟之中。我来帮忙好歹算是还你一个人情。

9000731.en: So it was you the Immortal Bird the Alliance prayed for. Why didn't you appear when they prayed for your arrival?
9000731.ch: 原来仙盟先辈祈求的仙鸟就是你。为何仙盟后人多次祈求，你却也无动于衷？

9000732.en: It was a long time ago. My soul was later scattered in different places, and I became weak and fell into a slumber. That's why I didn't hear their prayer. Otherwise, I wouldn't grudge helping them dispel some Nether Air.
9000732.ch: 估计那是很久以前的事了。其后我元神分离，修为大减，陷入蒙昧之中。因此仙盟累年求恳我都无法察觉，否则仅仅为他们驱散一点冥气，又岂会吝啬。

9000733.en: That day that girl activated the spells in the Altar to repel the monsters, and the Qi in the Altar rose high into the sky for it was the Day of Clear Sky. That's how I felt it and went out to find you in danger.
9000733.ch: 日前那位小妹子发动祈天台禁咒自保杀妖，又恰逢天清之日，祈天台所携灵气得以上涌高空，从而被我察觉这才机缘发现你们遇有困难。

9000734.en: Luo Ying's respect for me is one thing, but I stay here mainly because of you. Now I have returned the favor.
9000734.ch: 尽管骆瑛对我十分看重，我却是看在你对我有恩这才留下的。你我此后两清了。

9000735.en: Aunt Luo... You want a word with me?

9000736.en: Hmph, Master may have decided to demolish the Altar, but it was not that urgent. I asked him to lend me the Alliance Guards to save you, and so agreed to demolish it by the way.
9000736.ch: 哼，盟主虽已决定将祈天台毁去，却没打算立即将之拆毁，我希望借仙卫实力，抵御妖兽将你救回，这才答应盟主就此事伺机拆除祈天台。

9000737.en: You'd do anything to retrieve your father's works. Don't you have any common sense? Is your father the only one in the Altar that has works? And no one else does? Does anyone else put the whole Alliance in danger as you do?
9000737.ch: 你为了想取回你父亲的遗作，肆无忌惮至此，真叫我大开眼界。祈天台中就只有你的父亲有遗作么？大家没有？大家也像你一样肆意妄为，置仙盟于不顾？

9000739.en: You think an apology will put everything right? *sigh*

9000740.en: Gu Yuan'er keeps apologizing while sobbing. Luo Ying's stern face softens and embraces Gu Yuan'er with a sigh to comfort her. It takes her quite some time to calm Yuan'er down and send her away.
9000740.ch: 顾鸢儿泪如雨下，连声道歉。骆瑛原本严肃的神情瞬间消失，她一声长叹，抱住顾鸢儿连声安慰，好一阵后这才将顾鸢儿安慰下来劝走。

9000741.en: My friend, thank you so much for risking your life to save Yuan'er.
9000741.ch: 道友，此次多亏你冒险出手帮助鸢儿。

9000742.en: Master proposed to demolish the Altar shortly after Nangang, Yuan'er's father, had died. I'm under the Master, and it's not my place to question him. Maybe... he has his reasons.
9000742.ch: 盟主自鸢儿之父南罡去世之后，便倡议拆毁祈天台。老身终究是盟主的下属，岂敢揣测他的心意？唔……盟主……应该有自己的考虑吧。

9000743.en: Yuan'er is Nangang's only child. After he died, Yuan'er was all by herself. It's my duty to take good care of her. Since Master insisted on demolishing the Altar, I borrowed Alliance Guards from him to save Yuan'er and carry out the demolition work by the way.
9000743.ch: 南罡便只鸢儿这么一根独苗，他去世之后，鸢儿孤苦无依，我说什么也要将她照顾好的。既然盟主执意拆毁祈天台，我便借此向盟主借来仙卫，既救鸢儿，亦替盟主毁去高台。

9000744.en: The Altar was a peculiar structure, and it stored many of our predecessors' manuals and studies about Chi You. That's why I always proposed to reclaim the Altar. I thought there could be clues hidden in the books there that would help us solve some mysteries...
9000744.ch: 祈天台构造奇特，里面又保留许多仙盟前辈的心血秘籍和对赤幽州的诸多研究。因此我一向提议回收祈天台。我总以为里面藏有一些秘辛，只要能够查看里面的秘本书籍，一些难以索解的谜团或能因此找到蛛丝马迹……

9000745.en: But it was only my wishful thinking and could have been proven useless.
9000745.ch: 不过这也只是老身猜测而已，未必作得准。

9000746.en: It's a pity that the Altar was demolished, but Yuan'er managed to retrieve Nangang's works, so it was not all bad news. You invited Lady Sunny to the Alliance, and killed Taowu, one of the four ferocious beasts. It was a great contribution. I'd like to thank you. This is a treasure I got from Chi You. Please accept it. The Alliance will need your help.
9000746.ch: 拆毁祈天台虽然可惜，所幸鸢儿取回了南罡的著述，请来圣阳仙姑，还击杀四凶兽之一梼杌，总算大功一件。不过这都赖道友从中出力。这是我往日在赤幽州所得的秘宝。请道友收下。日后仙盟仰仗道友的地方多着呢。

9000748.en: Recently Jiuying is troubling us again. Perhaps she will launch another attack next month. Friend, I hope you would become more experienced, and assist the Alliance in the battle against the wave of monsters.
9000748.ch: 近日九婴越发猖獗，估计下个月又再来犯。希望道友尽快提升修为，助我仙盟战胜兽潮。

9000750.en: We are all wounded, and it's not wise to continue the battle. We should retreat today and come back to kill the monster after we recover...
9000750.ch: 大家都已负伤，再作纠缠恐怕也讨不了好去。今日先避过九婴锋芒，来日我们养精蓄锐再击杀此兽……

9000751.en: Under the command of Luo Ying, the Alliance Guards fighting the monsters beyond the wall begin to retreat, and the monsters take the chance to assault the wall. Their attack lasts for half a day before they leave.
9000751.ch: 在骆瑛主持之下，出城抵挡抵挡兽潮的仙卫陆续撤退，兽潮得此机会均猛冲城墙，半日后才渐渐散去。

9000752.en: With the order from the Master, the guards supported the wounded back to the Cultivator Alliance. However, just after Luo Ying and other members left, Gu Yuan'er hurries here.
9000752.ch: 盟主命令一下，仙卫立即扶持伤者回归仙盟。然而骆瑛等人才刚离去，顾鸢儿已匆忙赶到。

9000755.en: Jiuying is in command of the monsters, and it always strikes at our weakest point. It's a big threat to the Alliance! Not only it's quite strong itself... It always moves in a mysterious way, as if it knows what is happening within the Alliance.
9000755.ch: 这九婴啊，统帅群妖，避实击虚，真是仙盟的心腹大患！这妖本身实力就十分强大……而且神出鬼没，似乎能够通晓我们仙盟动向。

9000756.en: My father was also killed by Jiuying. Master and father joined hands to fight Jiuying, and in the end, father was killed, and Master was heavily wounded. I have always longed for permission to leave the town so that I can retrieve father's belongings and one day kill Jiuying myself!
9000756.ch: 爹爹就是死在这只九婴手上，盟主当时与爹爹合力对付九婴，爹爹失手牺牲，盟主也因此落下重创。我一直盼望出城，第一是为取回爹爹遗物，第二就是希望亲手击杀九婴！

9000757.en: Moves in a mysterious way? I sense a faint fragrance of Mulberry Branch in Jiuying's breath. It is resting in a lair several hundred leagues east of the wall.
9000757.ch: 神出鬼没？我察觉九婴体息之中似乎有淡淡扶桑枝香气。眼下它便在城墙外东边数百里一个巢穴之中暂栖。

9000758.en: Jiuying has been fighting the Alliance all these years, and it has its own wounds. If I guess it right, it's also healing its wounds like Elder Luo.
9000758.ch: 九婴长年与仙盟争锋相对，身上亦有创伤。若我所料不差，此时它与骆长老情形相仿，亦在疗愈自身伤势。

9000759.en: ...Oh, Chief Feng is very familiar with wounds caused by the Nether Air. I'm going to sound him out about Aunt Luo's wound. Please stay here to keep Aunt Luo company.
9000759.ch: ……啊，风族长对冥气造成的伤势十分了解，我得找他问问骆姑姑的情形。拜托你们在此陪陪姑姑。

9000760.en: My friend, I heard what Lady Sunny said to you... Please go after Yuan'er and take her back...
9000760.ch: 道友，圣阳娘娘与你们说的话我都听到了……请你马上将鸢儿追回……

9000761.en: I'm afraid she's not going to Chief Feng but sneaking out of town again to kill Jiuying before it fully recovers and revenges her father.
9000761.ch: 我担心小妮子此去不是找风族长，乃是私自出城，拟趁九婴疗伤之际出手将之击杀，以报父仇。

9000763.en: Elder Luo suspected you might be heading to Jiuying's lair alone. Seems she was right...
9000763.ch: 骆长老担心你私自前往九婴巢穴，而你果然……

9000764.en: If what Elder Sunny said is right, isn't it the best chance to kill Jiuying now? My father died in its hands. I won't stand by until it is dead.
9000764.ch: 依圣阳娘娘所言，现在不正是杀死九婴的机会么？我父亲死于九婴之手，我绝不会因为危险就罢手的。

9000765.en: With a determined face, Gu Yuan'er walks into the place mentioned by Sunny. It is a deep cave. Yuan'er feels something strange once she steps in. She thinks for a while and uses a spell to break a gap.
9000765.ch: 顾鸢儿一脸倔强，当先走进圣阳指点的地方。那是一个幽深的洞穴，鸢儿一经踏入随即察觉古怪，她苦思良久，竟让用启动某个禁咒打开了一个缝隙。

9000766.en: You walk through the gap and find yourselves not a mountain cave, but in a fine, tidy house. There are not many articles in the house, but enough for daily life. Jiuying is nowhere to be found, but Gu Yuan'er finds a bronze mirror in the drawer of a desk.
9000766.ch: 你们进入缝隙之后，发现里面根本不是山洞，而是一间精致干净的小屋。周围家具虽少，却足以生活。顾鸢儿在看周围并无九婴踪迹，却在一张案几抽屉之中取出一面铜镜。

9000767.en: This mirror! It seems to be an artifact made by my father...
9000767.ch: 这！有点像是爹爹手制的法宝……

9000770.en: I made this artifact to locate Jiuying. However...it's imbued with Nether Condensation. The Nether Air can corrupt one's mind and expose one's soul, and it will only do harm to whoever uses it often in the long run. But Jiuying is a much more urgent threat. We must use it despite its side effect.
9000770.ch: 此物为我特别研制，可以识别九婴位置。不过……镜中灌注冥晶，冥气侵蚀神识，照妖之余亦照内心，长久使用可对你我没什么好处。只是眼前一切以对付九婴为重，说不得，只好使用此物。

9000774.en: In fact, our forefathers knew it a long time ago. Monsters? They don't want to fight us cultivators either. Our narrative is actually the opposite of what has happened in Chi You. It's not monsters invading cultivators' territory, but cultivators occupying monsters' habitats.
9000774.ch: 其实我们家的先辈早就知道了，妖怪么？也不想对付我们修仙者。其实赤幽州的事情，要反过来看，不是妖兽要冒犯修仙者的地盘，反而是修仙者在一步一步压逼妖兽，让其失去生活的地方。

9000775.en: ...Hey, what's wrong with you? You look pale and sweat all over. Don't scare me...
9000775.ch: ……喂喂，你怎么了？你脸都青了，满头大汗的？别吓我……

9000776.en: *sigh* You don't look well. Let's take the mirror and leave here. Damn! Where on earth is Jiuying?!
9000776.ch: 唉！你看起来很不舒服的样子。我们拿走镜子，这便回去吧。可恶，九婴在哪？！

9000777.en: It is indeed an artifact made by Nangang. He said it could not only locate Jiuying but also corrupt its user's mind. I think it was the Nether Air stored in the artifact that invaded your mind and showed you the scenes that were recorded in the mirror.
9000777.ch: 这确是当年南罡所制法宝。依南罡所言，此物除去追踪九婴位置，亦会反噬使用者神识，是件利害并生的法宝。老身以为当是镜中冥气反噬道友神识以致道友看见镜中记录下来的一些片段。

9000778.en: Oh... My friend, even though the Nether Air in this mirror may corrupt its user's mind, it won't do too much harm. I hope you could find a way to repair it so that we can use it to find and kill Jiuying.
9000778.ch: 唔……道友，此镜尽管蕴含冥气侵蚀使用者神识，但害处不大。希望你能替老身走一趟，设法将镜子还原。此物一旦还原，或是击杀九婴的利器。

9000779.en: It's my own decision, and I hope you could keep it a secret before its function is restored... I hope you could understand.
9000779.ch: 对了，此事皆是老身自作主张，因此希望道友还原镜子功用之前，不要将镜子秘密道出……还盼道友体谅老身的难处。

9000780.en: So Jiuying was also wounded by the Mulberry Branch.
9000780.ch: 不想九婴亦曾受扶桑枝之伤。

9000781.en: The Mulberry Branch was a fascinating thing. Hou Yi once used it to wound me, and I really suffered a lot back then. Its fragrance is so faint that I might have just ignored it if I had not been heavily wounded by this arrow myself.
9000781.ch: 扶桑枝效用神妙，昔日后羿以之伤我，叫我吃了好大的亏。扶桑枝所携香气，一般人很难察觉，若非我为此箭所伤，创深痛巨，亦不易察觉。

9000782.en: It must be an elite cultivator in the Alliance who obtained the Mulberry Branch and used it to fight Jiuying. Jiuying may have been wounded by it, but it's still a dangerous ferocious beast.
9000782.ch: 想必仙盟昔日亦有高人因故获得扶桑枝并以之对付九婴。九婴或被扶桑枝所伤，但仍是绝代凶兽，对敌之际千万小心。

9000783.en: Aunt Luo is injured? Where is she?!
9000783.ch: 听说骆姑姑受伤了？她在哪？！

9000784.en: Elder Luo is wounded heavily. Guards have already brought her back to the Alliance for healing. Don't worry, Yuan'er, I will slay Jiuying soon or later, to revenge your father!
9000784.ch: 骆长老受伤颇重，已由仙卫送回仙盟疗伤。鸢儿别急，本座迟早为你击杀九婴，以报父仇！

9000785.en: Thank you, Master... I'll visit Aunt Luo!
9000785.ch: 有劳盟主……我去看看骆姑姑！

9000786.en: My friend, Elder Luo is in critical condition. Please visit her with us together.
9000786.ch: 道友，骆长老受伤颇重，也请你同去探视。

9000787.en: Gu Yuan'er is flipping the pages over while scratching her head. She looks disturbed...
9000787.ch: 顾鸢儿一边翻书，一边挠头，似乎十分苦恼……

9000788.en: *sigh* I know Aunt Luo wants to repair this mirror. I'll go through Chi You Anecdotes again to see if I can find any clues... As far as I know, this mirror is using some sort of Nether Condensation to generate energy. Maybe you could go explore around the wall to find some in places with dense Nether Air.
9000788.ch: 唉……我知道姑姑要还原这面镜子，我再翻翻《赤幽别志》看看能不能找到线索……就眼前来看，这枚镜子应该是以某种冥晶作为媒介产生能源的。或者你可以到城外找到一些冥气浓郁的地方设法寻得冥气结成的晶体。

9000789.en: The artifact bronze mirror starts to tremble. It displays your current location and a purple-black dot not far away from you. After a while, it is back to normal.
9000789.ch: 你身上的法宝铜镜突然间发出震动，上面竟显现出你目前地图方位并在不远处标出一个紫黑色的圆点。但是不过片刻，镜子重新没了动静。

9000790.en: You arrive at the place indicated by the mirror. It is quiet nearby, and you don't find any traces of monsters. You keep walking forward, and before long, you see a female cultivator searching around. She seems to know the specialness of this place as you do.
9000790.ch: 你去到标示地点的附近，不过此地十分平静，不似有妖兽踪迹。行走不远，只见一名修仙者女子正在周围查探，似乎亦发现此处异象。

9000791.en: It's very dangerous here. You'd better go back to town.
9000791.ch: 姑娘，城外十分危险，还是回入城中为好。

9000793.en: You see Jiuying bursting out its beast power in a cave, shattering the walls.
9000793.ch: 你看见一片山穴之中，九婴妖兽妖力爆发，震裂洞窟，威势十分可怕。

9000794.en: Dangerous? Those selfish cultivators claim to be the last line of defense and hunt monsters in Chi You. Which side is the dangerous one? The monsters, or the cultivators?
9000794.ch: 危险？修仙者自私自利，自称修仙者最后防线，来到赤幽州击杀妖兽，究竟是修仙者危险还是妖兽危险，中间大有商榷余地。

9000795.en: It once belonged to the late Alliance Elder Gu Nangang. Why are you having it?
9000795.ch: 此物乃顾南罡故长老所有，如何落入阁下手中？

9000796.en: Hah! Elder Gu devised this artifact driven by Nether Air Condensation to locate monsters with dense Nether Air in Chi You. He was a genius. But the Nether Air Condensation in the artifact has been depleted after being used for a long time.
9000796.ch: 呵，顾长老才华横溢，竟想到以冥晶作为媒介启用法宝，借此侦查赤幽州怀有巨大冥气的妖兽位置。此物久经使用，内里冥气结晶殆尽。

9000797.en: There is a deep cave of Nether Air Condensation about a hundred leagues from here. Just beware of the monsters lurking inside.
9000797.ch: 此去不过百里，有深窟一处，里面藏有冥气结晶。不过，该窟潜伏妖兽，阁下可要小心在意。

9000798.en: She turns on her heels after saying these words.
9000798.ch: 这名女子说完后别过头飘然去了。

9000799.en: You find a sleeping monster in the cave, and there are purple mosses on the wall. After looking more closely, they are actually Nether Air Condensations.
9000799.ch: 洞窟之中果然伏有沉睡妖兽，而洞中石壁之上一片片的紫色苔藓，细看之下才发现竟是冥气结晶。

9000800.en: Just as you are chipping off Nether Air Condensation, the sleeping monster opens its eyes. The female cultivator you just met appears. She presses her hands on your shoulders, indicating you to remain calm.
9000800.ch: 你挖去冥气结晶的同时，沉睡的妖兽眼睛突然张开，与此同时刚才路上所见的修仙女子突然出现，她轻轻按住你的肩膀，似乎盼你不要轻举妄动。

9000801.en: Don't panic! The monster may be strong, but it won't bother to stop you if you only want to chip off some Nether Air Condensation.
9000801.ch: 不要紧张！妖兽虽强，但只取冥气结晶，谅来不会为难你。

9000802.en: As you are about to leave the cave with Nether Air Condensation, the monster wakes up and pounces on you, waving its claws.
9000802.ch: 你准备带着冥气结晶慢慢退出，可妖兽突然觉醒，举起爪子朝你抓来。

9000803.en: It was only startled and doesn't mean to hurt you. Leave it to me.
9000803.ch: 妖兽只是失惊，并非有意攻击你。这就罢手吧。

9000804.en: The monster is poised to attack. The female cultivator gives it a stare, and the monster calms down and goes away. She heaves a sigh of relief.
9000804.ch: 妖兽还待攻击，你身边的女修仙者秀目一瞪，妖兽竟然气焰尽收，就此退去。女修仙者亦因此吁了口气。

9000805.en: Look, not all monsters are savage in nature or know nothing but killing...
9000805.ch: 看吧，妖兽不一定凶残成性，只知杀戮。

9000806.en: My name... I... I am Wu Yiman.

9000807.en: She takes her leave after telling you her name.
9000807.ch: 这名修仙女子说完，转身离开了。

9000808.en: Oh, if only I could go with you beyond the wall! You found some Nether Air Condensation?!
9000808.ch: 唉，真想跟你到城墙之外逛逛。咦！你真的找到冥气结晶了？！

9000809.en: You give the Nether Air Condensation to Gu Yuan'er, and she tinkers with it for a while before handing it back to you.
9000809.ch: 你将冥气结晶交给顾鸢儿，她将鼓捣半天后将镜子交还你手。

9000810.en: I think...it should work now. This Jiuying monster is very active, and I feel it is determined to kill our Master. Another Wave of Monsters may come soon. You'll get the chance to try it out!
9000810.ch: 我猜……这样应该能用了吧？这九婴好像特别活跃，而且我总觉得这妖兽就一门心思要击杀盟主，我估计兽潮很快就又要来袭，有机会你就试试好了！

9000811.en: Master also said that fighting Jiuying head-on should not be the only option we have. If you have any good ideas, you may as well do as you see fit!
9000811.ch: 盟主还说，击杀九婴并非只有正面交锋一途，道友若有妙计，不妨自主施行。

9000812.en: An onset of dizziness comes. The two strange voices begin another round of arguing.
9000812.ch: 你感觉一阵目眩，耳际再次传来那两个奇怪的声音。

9000813.en: Damn. I just need a scrap like you to sharpen my blade. Xaxaxa.
9000813.ch: 干，你这张废铁，不如给我当磨刀石如何？桀桀。

9000814.en: The sharpest blade breaks first. Isn't it your fate, too?
9000814.ch: 越锋利的刀刃也越容易折损，你就等着崩断损毁吧！

9000816.en: Maybe Duanmu Yinglan has found something strange inside you. She looks at you, surprised. But shortly after, her composed expression appears again; she must think it is too trivial to be treated seriously.
9000816.ch: 端木影阑似乎已察觉到你的古怪，她一脸诧异的看着。但不过片刻，她的神情恢复平静，恍如无事。

9000817.en: My friend, another Wave of Monsters has struck. Master and Elders are busy defending the Alliance. He asked me to tell you that Jiuying had regarded you as its biggest enemy, so you should avoid going beyond the wall for the moment.
9000817.ch: 道友，兽潮再度来袭，盟主正与各位长老全力防守。盟主让我传话，九婴已将道友视为心腹大患，因此请道友暂勿到城墙外参战。

9000818.en: After fueling it with the Nether Air Condensation, the artifact should be able to work again.
9000818.ch: 上次加入冥气结晶之后，法宝应该已能使用。

9000819.en: The Heartdream Mirror shows the monsters present as dots, and among them is a purple-black dot bigger than all the others. It must be Jiuying.
9000819.ch: 心梦镜标示出在场众多妖兽，其中一个一点紫黑色特别大，相信即是九婴位置所在。

9000820.en: You take a roundabout route to approach Jiuying and see a nine-headed monster observing the ongoing battle in the distance.
9000820.ch: 你慢慢绕到九婴所在位置，果然看见一只九头妖兽正在观望远方战局。

9000821.en: You want to take Jiuying by surprise, but another monster pounces on you from the side.
9000821.ch: 你正想暗中击杀九婴，不想旁边一只凶兽朝你猛扑而来。

9000822.en: After killing that monster, another strange scene appears in your mind. The monster that attacked you just now is talking to Jiuying. "You are putting your life at risk for a human."
9000822.ch: 你击杀那只凶兽之后，脑海里再次出现奇怪的画面；刚才偷袭你的凶兽对着九婴说：为了一个人类，你竟完全不顾自身安危。

9000823.en: I only want to do two things. To kill the Alliance Master, and to drive the Alliance back. Nothing more. Don't read too much into it.
9000823.ch: 我要做的只有两件事，杀死仙盟盟主，击退仙盟，舍此无他。你不要多心了。

9000824.en: You have killed monster Chaos, Jiuying has escaped and may as well have ordered the monsters to retreat with it. With the pressure lifted, the Alliance starts to counterattack and manages to repel the remaining monsters.
9000824.ch: 你虽然击杀混沌凶兽，九婴亦因此遁去；此妖临去之际似乎已勒令兽潮妖兽一并撤离，仙盟逐渐稳住阵脚，反攻妖兽，将其击退。

9000825.en: Master is waiting for you. Please go meet him, Elder. Congratulations on killing beast Chaos. You made yet another great contribution to the Alliance.
9000825.ch: 盟主有请，长老请即前往。恭喜长老击杀混沌凶兽，又立大功，属下这里先给长老道声喜。

9000826.en: You killed Chaos and made yet another great contribution to the Alliance! Now that all the ferocious beasts under Jiuying have been eliminated, have you given it a thought to how we could finish off Jiuying?
9000826.ch: 今日击杀混沌，真是大功一件！现在九婴身边的凶兽几乎已全部剪除。道友可有什么想法，好击杀九婴？

9000827.en: You're flattering me! I have complete confidence in you! Do as you see fit. But...
9000827.ch: 有什么好指教的？道友的实力，难道本座还不相信？道友请放手施为。不过……

9000828.en: Jiuying is a sly monster and always moves in a mysterious way. But you seem capable of tracking it. I wonder if you have any tricks to manage that?
9000828.ch: 九婴神出鬼没，一向十分狡诈，但我看道友似乎能察知九婴动向。这就十分不易，道友可是有什么奇谋？

9000829.en: What? You are in an important meeting with Master? Aunt Luo just sent me to invite you for a chat.
9000829.ch: 啊？原来盟主在跟你说重要的事情么？骆姑姑还让我来请你过去一趟呢。

9000831.en: Elder, Aunt Luo said you were wounded in the fight with Chaos. A wound by Nether Air is no small matter, so she asked Chief Feng and Lady Sunny to heal you.
9000831.ch: 骆姑姑说，长老与混沌凶兽生死角逐之际似乎受了伤，冥气之伤不可小觑，因此请来风族长和圣阳仙姑为长老稳住伤势。

9000832.en: I see. I was so eager to finish off Jiuying that I didn't notice your wound. Please go to Elder Luo's place and have your wound healed. We can talk again later.
9000832.ch: 原来如此。倒是本座着急击杀九婴，竟未发现长老您身怀伤势。既是如此，长老便先去骆长老那边吧。我们稍后再谈。

9000833.en: Master... I'm sorry... I didn't know you were having a meeting.
9000833.ch: 盟主……对不起啊……我不知道你们在说话。

9000834.en: That's all right. You may go now.

9000835.en: Aunt Luo, you were right. Master let me take Elder here right away.
9000835.ch: 姑姑，你料得不差，盟主果然叫我带长老来这呢。

9000836.en: Of course. Our friend is Master's right-hand champion now. By the way, Yuan'er, the Wave of Monsters is moving in a strange way lately. I want you to go to the wall and watch them closely. If anything strange should happen, come and tell me at once.
9000836.ch: 道友乃盟主爱将，盟主自然十分关心。鸢儿，近日兽潮动向十分奇怪，也请你到城墙之上多多留意。若有异动，即来禀告。

9000837.en: Oh? I...I... Yes! I'm going at once.
9000837.ch: 啊？……我……我去留意？好！这就去。

9000839.en: Perhaps some episodes in the Heartdream Mirror have recovered? Could you please tell me?
9000839.ch: 心梦镜中可是已有部分片段恢复了？长老可否相告？

9000840.en: ...Well, I hope I was wrong... When Nangang was still alive, the mirror was available anytime, but now it is still incomplete. Please collect more Nether Air Condensation to further restore it.
9000840.ch: ……这样子么，但愿一切都是我料错了……昔日南罡在时，心梦镜可说随心而用，眼前法宝还需继续还原。请你继续收集冥气结晶，籍此还原心梦镜。

9000841.en: Theoretically, since the Heartdream Mirror is driven by Nether Air Condensation, the only way to restore it is to find more pure Nether Air Condensation beyond the wall where Nether Air gathers.
9000841.ch: 按理说，心梦镜以冥气结晶作为媒介发动开启，那么想进一步还原心梦镜唯一的办法就是到城墙外有冥气的地方继续寻找纯净的冥气结晶。

9000842.en: You have just left the Alliance wall, and the Heartdream Mirror shows there is a Monster with powerful Nether Air nearby...
9000842.ch: 你才离开仙盟城墙不久，心梦镜再次标示出有极强大的冥气妖兽存……

9000843.en: You arrive at the destination, but only find Duanmu Yinglan, the female cultivator you met before. She is looking around as if searching for something. The last time you saw her, she was haughty and aloof. But today she looks very sad.
9000843.ch: 你去到心梦镜标示的位置，但面前只有此前遇见的女修仙者端木影澜。她四顾周遭，像在寻找什么。之前遇见的端木影澜清冷高傲，但当下的她却显得十分伤心。

9000845.en: Duanmu Yinglan sees you and casts a sharp glance at you. Her eyes dim down shortly after...
9000845.ch: 端木影澜立即察觉了你的存在，她向你投来凌厉的目光，但瞬间又即淡然……

9000846.en: You said it was dangerous beyond the wall, yet you are out here again. Why?
9000846.ch: 此前你与我说城墙之外十分危险，你却已经两度独自来到城墙之外了，这却又为何？

9000847.en: I see. I know another place with hidden Nether Air Condensation. I can tell you where to find it.
9000847.ch: 原来如此，我还知道另外一处藏有冥气结晶的地方，告诉你亦不妨。

9000848.en: You were too reckless to awaken the monster last time and almost started a fight. This time I'll go with you into the cave lest it would happen again. But first, I want you to go with me to another place.
9000848.ch: 上次取晶颇为莽撞，终于让妖兽知觉，几乎大战起来。此次我陪你进洞取宝，免得又起争端。不过这之前，你得陪我走一趟。

9000849.en: One of my friends disappeared several years ago... I have always been looking for him since then...
9000849.ch: 我的朋友多年以前失踪了……我一直在寻他……

9000850.en: What do you say? If you accept, we are leaving now.
9000850.ch: 呵，你看如何？答应的话，我们这便启程。

9000852.en: Duanmu Yinglan leads you to a mysterious cave. After pondering for a while, she strides inside. Suddenly, a noise breaks out, and shiny blades fly toward Duanmu Yinglan.
9000852.ch: 端木影澜带你来到一个神秘洞窟。她想了想，随即大踏步进入内里；但里面突然声响猛作，虚空之中生成一片闪光，刀刃一般朝端木影澜切来。

9000853.en: After defeating the monsters, Duanmu Yinglan looks around. She took on a soft expression, as if reminiscing about the past. She takes a walk around the cave, and then turns depressed and heaves a sigh.
9000853.ch: 你击败突袭的灵体后，端木影澜开始四周查看。她表情突然变得十分温柔，似在追忆什么往事。但是她在洞中走了一圈后，却又变得十分沮丧，继而发出长叹。

9000854.en: Why isn't he here?! Thank you for protecting me... I want to be alone. The Nether Air Condensation you want is not far away... to the east... I never thought the artifact was activated in this way... I don't feel well. Please excuse me.
9000854.ch: 不在了？！多谢你保护我……我想自己待着，你需要的冥气结晶就在不远处……不远处的东方，万万没想到这枚法宝原是用这种法子启用……我有点不适，告辞。

9000855.en: You find the cave Duanmu Yinglan mentioned. A bunch of Nether Air Condensations cling to the wall like vines, and black smokes surge around them.
9000855.ch: 你找到结晶洞窟，一簇冥气结晶好像疯长的植物长在内里洞壁。结晶上还飘散阵阵黑气。

9000856.en: However, as you go near them, monsters there stand up one by one. They have sensed your intrusion and stand up to attack you.
9000856.ch: 然而你一接近冥晶，周围站起一只只妖兽，他们察觉到入侵的你，纷纷站起朝你发起攻势。

9000857.en: This time the monsters charge at you crazily, unlike the last time when you and Duanmu Yinglan went inside the cave together. After several fierce battles, all the monsters are finally down.
9000857.ch: 此次妖兽拼了命一样跟你厮杀，迥异先前端木影澜与你一起探寻洞窟的情景。经过连番恶战，你才将妖物一一击败。

9000858.en: ...I have obtained enough Nether Condensation. Gu Yuan'er is familiar with this mirror. I shall ask her to reactivate it.
9000858.ch: ……冥晶已足，顾鸢儿应较为了解此镜，便由她重新启动法宝吧。

9000859.en: You found more Nether Air Condensation? Not bad! I have learned a lot after reading Chi You Anecdotes, and now I know something about the mechanism of the artifact Heartdream Mirror. Let's infuse the Nether Air Condensation into it.
9000859.ch: 了不起啊，你竟真的找到这种冥气结晶。我钻研《赤幽别志》颇有所得，爹爹法宝心梦镜的启动原理我已有些头绪了。我们这便试着将冥晶注入镜中吧。

9000860.en: Gu Yuan'er grinds the Nether Condensation into fluid and injects it into the mirror. The mirror starts to shine, and you feel dizzy as more episodes appear in your mind.
9000860.ch: 顾鸢儿将冥晶研碎成液，再将之导入镜中。镜子突然光芒大盛，同时你感觉到丹田剧烈一跳，眼前一阵眩晕，脑海里泛出许多片段。

9000862.en: ...What happened? This mirror is driven by the Nether Air, which you may access in cultivation... You were corrupted by the mirror?
9000862.ch: ……究竟是怎么回事？此镜以冥气驱动，你们修炼之际也接触冥气……镜子会因此对你们进行反噬的……

9000863.en: Elder, Master wants to see you. He is waiting for you outside the Alliance. He said he wanted to discuss with you something important. He said you should bring the artifact with you to discuss the plan to kill Jiuying.
9000863.ch: 拜见长老，盟主有请。他老人家在仙盟外碧桃林等候，说有紧要事情商量。他交代属下叮嘱长老您带上法宝一同前去，好研究击杀九婴的办法。

9000864.en: Master said Elder Luo would also join your meeting.
9000864.ch: 呃，盟主说，骆长老也在，你们正好一同商量。

9000865.en: The episodes stored in the mirror keep flashing in your mind...
9000865.ch: 脑海之中不断闪现镜中保留的神识片段……

9000867.en: You arrive in a shadowy forest and find Luo Ying bound by mysterious spells and kneeling on the ground. She notices you and looks flustered.
9000867.ch: 你来到一处阴暗的丛林之中，骆瑛神奇的禁咒束缚跪倒地上。她看见你来到，神色立即变得十分惊慌。

9000868.en: Go! Return to the Alliance! No, leave Chi You!
9000868.ch: 快走！回去仙盟！不，离开赤幽州！

9000869.en: Someone appears from behind Luo Ying. He's pointing his sword at Luo Ying's back. It's the Alliance Master.
9000869.ch: 骆瑛背后走出一人，此人手握长剑点住骆瑛背心，他是仙盟之主。

9000870.en: Here, give me the Heartdream Mirror. It's the key artifact to hunting down monster Jiuying.
9000870.ch: 晚了。小朋友，交出心梦镜。那是击杀九婴妖兽的关键法宝。

9000871.en: He's mad! He's the one who killed Yuan'er's father. You must leave!
9000871.ch: 这人已经疯了！他是杀死鸢儿父亲的元凶。不要留在这。

9000872.en: Luo Ying, that's not a pleasant thing to say. I turned a blind eye to your investigation only because we were once schoolmates.
9000872.ch: 骆瑛，你这么说我可就不高兴了。若非念在你我昔日同门学艺的份上，岂能容你一直暗中查探我呢？

9000874.en: What kind of Alliance Master would I be if I had no idea what my subordinates were doing? Besides, you were always proposing to reclaim the Heaven Sacrifice Altar. Wasn't it because you wanted to find the clues there? You may have hidden it from others, but not me.
9000874.ch: 身为盟主，手下在干什么也没点头绪，未免就太糊涂了。再说，你屡次要回收祈天台，不就盼在那里找到一点蛛丝马迹么？你瞒得了别人，却瞒不了我。

9000875.en: Now, give me the Heartdream Mirror, or I'll kill this bitch.
9000875.ch: 小朋友，心梦镜拿来。否则我立即杀了骆瑛这恶妇。

9000876.en: Go! If you have the mirror, he will still fear it. If you hand it over, we will both die!
9000876.ch: 现在就走，不交心梦镜此人心中忌惮，不敢相逼，若交出法宝，你我都要被没命！

9000877.en: Good. Honestly, it pains me to take your life. You only had eyes for Nangang back then. I suppose you must regret it now?
9000877.ch: 很好。师妹，要杀你，我还真有些舍不得呢。当年你眼里只有南罡，想必现在也很后悔吧？

9000878.en: Alliance Master waves his sword at Luo Ying, but it turns to you halfway.
9000878.ch: 盟主举剑朝骆瑛劈下，但中途剑锋一偏，竟朝你撩了过来。

9000880.en: Alliance Master has left Luo Ying aside, and waves his sword at you while chanting spells to converge Energy.
9000880.ch: 盟主放过骆瑛，一手挥剑一手捏剑诀凝聚灵力朝你攻来。

9000881.en: He still has some old wounds. Hold out and you will be able to defeat him then!
9000881.ch: 盟主身上有旧创，支持下去，定能取胜！

9000883.en: Luo Ying... So you knew it from the beginning...

9000884.en: After you and Nangang returned from your visit to the Tree Vault, you shut yourself up cultivating and then were away for a month. After you returned, you had those wounds... It was Xingtian...
9000884.ch: 那次南罡与你深入到建木之后，你曾闭关数月，然后外出一月，回来时，你就带了伤势……是刑天……

9000885.en: Luo Ying... Do anything you like, but please don't kill me... Please...
9000885.ch: 骆瑛……我只求你饶我一命，其他任凭处置……师妹……

9000887.en: Many things back then are still shrouded in mystery. Could you leave him to me? I want to find out the truths.
9000887.ch: 当年许多事情仍然成谜，可否将他交给我？老身希望将往事一一查明。

9000888.en: You remove the spells binding Luo Ying, and she walks slowly toward Alliance Master with caution, only to find him regaining his cruelty.
9000888.ch: 你为骆瑛解去身上束缚，骆瑛则小心翼翼的接近盟主。但盟主眼光之中突然闪出凶狠的光芒。

9000889.en: You are one of the best cultivators in the Alliance, almost on a par with us men. But you are a soft woman after all.
9000889.ch: 师妹见识不让我等须眉男子，修为又高，实是仙盟一等一的人才，只可惜终究改不了妇人之仁的毛病。

9000890.en: Luo Ying is held hostage by Alliance Master. Suddenly, a shriek is heard from the distance, and a fireball flies over, hitting Alliance Master. He is forced to let go of Luo Ying and rolls on the ground like a fireball himself before ending up dead.
9000890.ch: 骆瑛遭到盟主挟持，此时远处一声婴鸣，一团真火横空而来烧中盟主。他瞬间放脱了骆瑛变成一个翻滚的火球。不多时便没了动静。

9000891.en: Monster Jiuying appears and transforms into a human. It's Duanmu Yinglan!
9000891.ch: 九婴妖兽突然出现，然后突然雾化变成人形。那是端木影澜！

9000892.en: Don't let Jiuying destroy the Heartdream Mirror!
9000892.ch: 心梦镜不能被九婴毁去！

9000893.en: Duanmu Yinglan raises her hand, and the Heartdream Mirror is shattered into pieces.
9000893.ch: 端木影澜抬手一挥，心梦镜顿时碎裂。

9000895.en: Could you follow me somewhere? I'll wait for you here.
9000895.ch: 可以请你随我走一趟么？我在这边等你。

9000896.en: Duanmu Yinglan walks past Luo Ying and picks up something from the "lump of charcoal" on the ground. She gives you a cold glance and walks away to wait for you.
9000896.ch: 端木影澜根本不理骆瑛，她从地上那具“焦炭”身上取走什么东西，然后冷冷的看你一眼，这才走到远处等候。

9000897.en: It's too strange for Jiuying to appear and kill Master. Stay away from her. I'll fight it myself! Arrgh...
9000897.ch: 九婴突然出现击杀盟主，这中间必有古怪，你不可贸然接近。等我来斗九婴妖兽！呃……

9000898.en: Luo Ying was wounded when she was held hostage by Alliance Master. She is unable to kill Jiuying even if she wants to.
9000898.ch: 骆瑛为盟主所擒似乎已经受了伤，看来她就想击杀九婴也无能为力了。

9000899.en: Follow me. You said you would help me find my friend if I help you find the Nether Air Condensation. Now I know where my friend is.
9000899.ch: 陪我走一趟吧。之前你说过，帮你取得冥气结晶，你就陪我找朋友。现今我已知道我朋友在哪了。

9000900.en: Duanmu Yinglan walks in front of you and leads you into a cave. A young man is lying on the ground, his face still alive, but his breath is long gone. Duanmu Yinglan falls to the ground and starts sobbing...
9000900.ch: 端木影澜走在前面，这次她一下子就找到了洞窟。里面一名少年仰躺地上，虽然面目栩栩如生，但生机已绝。端木影澜见了眼前情景一下跪倒，然后低下了头无声饮泣，泪下如注。

9000901.en: You feel similar to him... If humans and monsters were not enemies, I would like to be friends with you... You must have many questions... I can only give you a brief account...
9000901.ch: 你气质上有点像他……若非人妖殊途，我倒盼望能与你交个朋友……对了，你一定有许多疑问……我只能择要说说……

9000902.en: I was captured by Alliance Master when I was young and have been since locked in a cave. This man was locked there too, and he accompanied me through the darkest years of my life. He later helped me escape, but he was captured again when he returned to steal the Heartdream Mirror for me.
9000902.ch: 我幼时为仙盟盟主抓获，长年被囚禁穴窟之中。眼前男子则是陪伴我度过最艰难时光的人。后来他助我脱身，自己却因为回头取心梦镜给我而重新遭到盟主擒获。

9000903.en: He always dreamed about spending his life in a quiet place. Since I became the leader of the monsters, I have always been trying to rescue him, and I built a small house for him so that he could move there once he was set free. I also put the Heartdream Mirror there, and you found that place and took away the mirror.
9000903.ch: 他一直希望有个地方清静度日，我成为妖兽统领后除去时时设法救出他，还经营了一间小屋，盼望他有朝一日脱困之后，就能有个落脚的地方。同时，我亦将心梦镜放在那里。而你后来竟然找到了那个地方并取走心梦镜。

9000904.en: The Nether Air in the Heartdream Mirror would corrupt its user's mind and reveal the past episodes to the user. You can see what the mirror once saw and find out about Alliance Master's crimes. And I can track Alliance Master by means of the Nether Air.
9000904.ch: 心梦镜中的冥气侵蚀神识，可以让使用者看见一些以往的片段。你会从中看见一连窜事件，甚至洞悉盟主恶行。而我，亦能以冥气，追寻到盟主的踪迹。

9000905.en: To save my friend, I must get the secret key of Alliance Master to open the hidden cave. He would never stand by if anyone should find out about his crimes. He would find you and kill you and take back the Heartdream Mirror. That would be my best chance.
9000905.ch: 要救回他，就必须找到盟主身上的密钥，开启他暗中设下的洞天秘境。盟主心肠歹毒，若有人知道他当年恶行，岂能容他活下去。他会找到你，并设法杀死你，顺便缴回心梦镜。这正是我的机会。

9000906.en: You cultivators are not sensitive to the Nether Air. I helped you obtain the Nether Air Condensation not only to let you see the truths but also to track Alliance Master with this mirror as bait.
9000906.ch: 你们修仙者对冥气终究不甚敏感，而我当日陪你取得冥气结晶，为的除去重启心梦镜让你看见真相，亦为能够以此镜为标的，追寻盟主踪迹。

9000907.en: I waited for you to fight each other so that I could take Alliance Master by surprise. I killed him and took the key, and I found this hidden cave and my friend.
9000907.ch: 你们大打出手，正是我乘虚偷袭的时机，我击杀盟主取回他的秘钥，因此终于找到这处隐秘洞天，也终于找到他了。

9000908.en: But he had already died... Since his body had been corrupted by Nether Air, his flesh wouldn't rot. I can still stay at his side and look him in the face.
9000908.ch: 可惜他已经先我一步去了……好在，他体质特异，为冥气侵蚀，肉身不腐。所以打后日子我还能日日夜夜看着他。

9000909.en: But as the leader of the monsters, I can't let you cultivators invade further into our land and kill our kin. And...you killed Chaos. I must avenge him.
9000909.ch: 不过，我身为妖兽统领，却不能任得你们修仙者一再推进，残害我的同胞。而且……你杀死混沌，此仇不能不报。

9000910.en: If I lose to you, I will leave Chi You and never command the Wave of Monsters again. If you lose to me, please leave Chi You and never bully us monsters again...
9000910.ch: 此一战，若我输了，自当绝迹赤幽州，从此不管兽潮的事情。若你输了，请你也离开赤幽州，不要再与我妖兽为难……

9000912.en: This is an inevitable fight. Chaos was my friend, and you killed him. I must avenge him no matter what. Let it begin.
9000912.ch: 这一战避无可避，混沌终究是我的朋友，你杀了他，我无论如何也要为他报仇。出手吧。

9000913.en: Monster Jiuying is defeated and transforms into her human form. She falls to the ground, her face cold, but her eyes watering again...
9000913.ch: 九婴妖兽不敌你手，慢慢变回人身。她一把坐倒在地，脸上冷冷的没有一丝情绪，眼中泪水却再次汹涌而出。

9000915.en: Aunt Luo sent me a telepathic voice asking me to check on you...
9000915.ch: 骆姑姑传音给我，要我过来看看你……

9000916.en: You were defeated. I suppose you won't participate in the Wave of Monsters again, right? I'll...spare you today... Let's go.
9000916.ch: 既然输了，想必你也不会再掺和仙盟的战事了吧？今天……今天就饶你不死……我们走吧。

9000917.en: With Gu Yuan'er's support by your arm, you walk away.
9000917.ch: 顾鸢儿搀着你走远了一点。

9000918.en: I came here when you were still fighting. And I found this in the cave... Here.
9000918.ch: 你们打的时候我早就来了，我到洞窟里看见这个……给你。

9000919.en: This monster was a wretched soul... She fought us Alliance because she wanted to find her friend...
9000919.ch: 这只妖兽其实也是个可怜人……之前她一直与我们为难是因为心里还有放不下的东西……

9000920.en: Now she has taken her revenge on Master, and the man she held dear has left her. I think she was desperate and initiated this duel with you so that she could...die in your hands.
9000920.ch: 可现在，盟主的大仇报了，她珍惜的人又离她而去，因此我觉得她早已万念俱灰。所谓决斗报仇，更像……是借你的手给她来个干脆……

9000921.en: She asked you to kill her... But I couldn't help stopping you... I suppose...she will spend the rest of her life in this room...
9000921.ch: 她刚刚叫你动手……可我实在不忍心……我想……她余生都会在这间房子里面度过吧……

9000922.en: You follow Yuan'er's finger and see Duanmu Yinglan has returned to the cave. She stares blankly at the man lying on the ground, tears falling in a downpour from her eyes, yet her lips curled in a smile...
9000922.ch: 鸢儿伸手一指，端木影澜已经回到洞中，她怔怔的瞧着地上男子，双眼泪如雨下，嘴上却露出了几分笑意……

9000924.en: This is the diary Gu Yuan'er found in the secret cave.
9000924.ch: 这是顾鸢儿在端木影澜发现的秘窟中找到的书信。

9000925.en: That Xiang Lingjun is a devil. He captured me and locked me in this cave. I will break into his Azure Peach Mansion and kill him after I have enough Tao!
9000925.ch: 万恶的向令钧，竟将我抓来关在这个洞府之中，别让我练成道法，到时我定要杀入你的碧桃别馆将你千刀万剐！

9000926.en: He captured me because my body was different than others and could resist more Nether Air.
9000926.ch: 向魔头将我抓来，竟是因为我体质异于常人，能够抵御更多的冥气。

9000928.en: It has been two months. Xiang Lingjun found out I was cultivating in secret. He removed my Spiritual Root, and I can't break through realms to grow stronger anymore...
9000928.ch: 已经过去两个多月了。向令钧察觉到我在暗中修炼。他摘去了我的灵根，让我无法突破境界增进修为……

9000929.en: Xiang Lingjun used to infuse Nether Air into my body. These days he forced me to swallow down ground Nether Air Condensation...
9000929.ch: 向令钧往日往我体内注入冥气，近日他还逼我吃下捣碎的冥气结晶……

9000930.en: Xiang Lingjun finally appeared... This time he captured a young woman!
9000930.ch: 向令钧终于出现了……他抓来了一名年轻女子！

9000931.en: She was taken away by that devil again, and when she returned, she was spitting blood.
9000931.ch: 这女子又被魔头提了出去了，她回来后不断在呕血

9000932.en: She was taken away by Xiang Lingjun again, and when she returned, she was spitting blood again, and she was somewhat delirious.
9000932.ch: 那个女子又被向令钧提了出去。回来时她呕了很多血，而且神智似乎有点混乱。

9000933.en: This woman said she was Monster Jiuying! She must have suffered too much torture and lost her consciousness.
9000933.ch: 这个女子！估计她被折磨的太难受了，所以迷迷糊糊说了很多话，她说自己是九婴妖兽！

9000934.en: What on earth does Xiang Lingjun want? He captured even monster Jiuying...
9000934.ch: 向令钧究竟想干什么？他将九婴妖兽都抓来了……

9000935.en: The Spirit Shackles are actually Qi infused to block the circulation of original Qi in the body. Without my Spiritual Root, I can't remove Jiuying's shackles. But she still has her monster power. She can transfer the Spirit Shackles into my body.
9000935.ch: 静灵枷其实就输入灵气截断人体灵气交通。我灵根被摘，无法解开九婴的枷锁。但她妖力还在，可以将灵枷反过来送进我体内。

9000936.en: Jiuying agreed to take me up on my plan. She is clever. I can guess most of the methods Xiang Lingjun has used to torture her, and as for the rest, I can figure them out after studying for a few days.
9000936.ch: 我说要气炸向令钧，九婴竟答应了。她悟性很高，向令钧种入她体内的各种折磨手段我大约都知道，不知道的研究两三日大都明了。

9000937.en: Jiuying told me she was the daughter of the previous Jiuying. Xiang Lingjun found her in her lair when she was still a cub and locked her up to raise her in human form.
9000937.ch: 九婴跟我说，她原本是九婴老妖的女儿，初生之际被向令钧在巢穴中发现带离，并设法塑造人形，关起来抚养。

9000938.en: Xiang Lingjun's vileness was beyond imagination. He transformed Qi into spikes to infuse into Jiuying's body...
9000938.ch: 向令钧心思真是歹毒，竟将灵气转为尖刺，注入九婴体内……

9000939.en: I told her my name, Duanmu Shenghan, but it was actually me who wanted to know her name.
9000939.ch: 我把我的名字端木胜寒告诉她，但其实是我想知道她叫什么名字。

9000940.en: Yinglan was only nice to me out of gratitude?
9000940.ch: 影澜是因为感激我所以才对我好么？

9000941.en: Yinglan seems to be happy these days. But it's not a life that will or should last forever...
9000941.ch: 影澜好像也很快乐。但长此以往，却不是办法……

9000942.en: I told Yinglan my plan, and she seemed to be convinced.
9000942.ch: 我跟影澜说了我的计划，影澜似乎已被我打动了。

9000943.en: I once read about the artifact Heartdream Mirror from the secret tomes of the Alliance and learned it could track monsters with strong Nether Air. It's in Xiang Lingjun's hands.
9000943.ch: 昔日从仙盟秘典中得知有心梦镜法宝，可以追踪怀有强大冥气的妖兽。向令钧持有此法宝。

9000944.en: Yinglan doesn't know this plan of mine, and she asked me what I would do after leaving here.
9000944.ch: 影澜不知我心中打算，还问离开这里以后要怎么过？

9000945.en: I haven't figured out what happened. A strange and loud baby-like cry is heard in the distance.
9000945.ch: 你还没明白究竟发生何事，远方一声奇特的婴儿叫鸣，响彻四野。

9000946.en: My friend, Jiuying has commanded the Wave of Monsters to charge at the Alliance wall. Master hopes you could help us defend it.
9000946.ch: 道友好，九婴发动兽潮猛冲我仙盟城墙；盟主希望道友能参战协助。

9000948.en: You come to the floating island and view the battlefield from above. You see the Master and several Elders are fighting Jiuying together.
9000948.ch: 你去到浮岛上，俯瞰下方兽潮战场。其时盟主与骆瑛等几位长老正联手对付九婴。

9000949.en: You go up to Master, and he points beyond the wall. Monsters are charging at the wall below. You feel the wall shaking under your feet, and more monsters are coming from the distance. The situation is dire.
9000949.ch: 你来到盟主身边，他往城墙外指点，只见城墙下方妖兽不断冲击城墙。你分明感觉脚底传来震动，而远方大股妖兽汹涌逼近，情势果然凶险。

9000950.en: My friend, this is the Wave of Monsters. Whenever Xingtian waves his axe, all the monsters in Chi You would turn mad. And Jiuying is commanding the monsters to charge at our line of defense.
9000950.ch: 道友，这便是兽潮。刑天挥动战斧后，会影响赤幽州一切妖物，使之凶猛失常。而九婴则指挥联合这些妖兽冲击我仙盟防线。

9000951.en: We have Alliance Guards near all the strongholds hunting the monsters, and this part of the wall is the weakest point in our line of defense. I want to put you in charge here.
9000951.ch: 如今各处据点均有仙卫出外击杀妖物，只眼前这方城墙防守最是薄弱。守住此处的重任，本座想交给你。

9000952.en: Master, for someone who joined the Alliance not long ago and has only dealt with a few isolated monsters, isn't it too much of a burden to join the war against the Wave of Monsters all of a sudden?
9000952.ch: 盟主，加入仙盟不久之人，只对付过后方一些妖兽，仓促间参与兽潮之战似乎……

9000953.en: Our friend killed a ferocious beast in the battle at the Altar and proved to be highly capable. Elder Luo, you are too cautious.
9000953.ch: 道友于祈天台一战击杀凶兽，可见实力不凡。骆长老似乎太过谨慎了。

9000955.en: You have defeated the monsters charging at the wall, and suddenly you hear the roar of a nine-headed monster charging at you while spitting out water and fire. Alliance Master, who has been watching atop the wall, jumps down with several Elders to engage it.
9000955.ch: 你将冲击城墙的妖兽击退，此时一声怪叫响起，一只九头妖极速接近，口喷水火，朝你发起攻势。原本在城墙上观战指挥的盟主见状，与几名长老一起飞落城墙与妖兽恶战。

9000956.en: Light flashing in his eyes, he heads straight into the tide of monsters. In the distance, Master joins the troop, seeming to be fighting with some fierce monsters. But a moment later, Master comes to you, looking somewhat pale.
9000956.ch: 他眼中光芒一闪直扑兽潮之中，远处声息大作，似乎盟主加入战团后正与什么厉害妖物激战。但不过片刻，盟主脸色略带苍白回到你这边来。

9000957.en: That monster is only good at fleeing...

9000958.en: *cough* Well, you were strong enough to repel the Wave of Monsters. Jiuying found out about you and maneuvered monsters in the hope of killing you. I think the Wave of Monsters today should be over. Jiuying will command her underlings to retreat soon.
9000958.ch: 咳咳……嗯，你修为不弱，撼动兽潮阵势。九婴及时发现因此调度其余妖兽盼望将你击杀。想来今日兽潮至此而尽，九婴马上便会约束手下退去。

9000959.en: *cough* I'm fine. It's just some old wounds. You should return to the Alliance and take some rest. I want to talk to you later in the Wenshu Mansion.
9000959.ch: 咳，无妨，一点旧伤而已。道友回到仙盟稍作休息后，还请到问枢院中与本座一聚。

9000960.en: Elder Luo, this Jiuying was a formidable foe. She seemed able to see through our formation. It was more and more difficult to repel her.
9000960.ch: 骆长老，这九婴着实了得，仿佛又再识破我等攻守法度，越发不好对付了。

9000961.en: Yeah, just now it intended to divide us, before trying to hunt down our stronger fighters.
9000961.ch: 不错，刚才分明是有意分割开我等，再设法围堵实力较强的战力。

9000963.en: I didn't know you asked our friend to meet you, Master. I'll take my leave then.
9000963.ch: 盟主原来约了道友见面。老身先行告退。

9000964.en: You will be affected by Nether Air once you join the battle against the Wave of Monsters. This True Sight Smoke can protect you from it, and it's colorless and odorless. Please take it with you.
9000964.ch: 道友参与兽潮之战难免沾染冥气。这道真视灵烟，萦绕身周无色无臭，可稍微阻隔冥气。还请道友带着。

9000965.en: It's not worth mentioning. Since Jiuying has seen you as a big threat, you will meet greater danger in future battles against the monsters.
9000965.ch: 小小法宝可算不得什么。九婴既然出手合围道友，想必日后道友加入战团，亦会更加危险。

9000966.en: Hmph! That's right! Xingtian waving his axe only makes the monsters more savage, but this Jiuying can command and maneuver the monsters to counter our defense formation.
9000966.ch: 哼！不错！刑天挥动战斧，充其量将妖兽变得穷凶极恶。这九婴却似妖兽之中的统帅，知道调度分派。处处针对我等防御阵势。

9000967.en: As long as Jiuying is alive, we Alliance will never get the upper hand in the war against the Wave of Monsters. I must bring her down as soon as possible so that our successors can go further inland to kill Xingtian.
9000967.ch: 九婴不死，仙盟也无法在这兽潮之战中反客为主。本座定要尽快办下这件大事，好让仙盟后来者深入内陆击杀刑天。

9000968.en: You should go back and rest today. We are looking forward to your contribution to future battles.
9000968.ch: 道友今日先请回去歇息。来日激战，还得仰仗道友实力。

9000969.en: Your heart suddenly palpitates. Two voices are speaking in your mind.
9000969.ch: 你突然感觉心脏猛跳几下，脑海里同时响起两个声音。

9000970.en: KILL! I'll kill every living thing, in every corner of the world!
9000970.ch: 杀！杀尽一切生灵，我要八荒之中再无活物！！

9000971.en: Sinful one, you know nothing but slaughter. I'll not see it done.
9000971.ch: 只知杀戮的孽障，我不会让你得逞的。

9000972.en: Damn... I'll cut you in half! IN HALF!
9000972.ch: 干……我要将你一剖两半！一剖两半！！

9000974.en: Just after Luo Ying left here, your heart begins to palpitate. You hear the two voices arguing again...
9000974.ch: 骆瑛才刚刚离开，你的心脏剧跳几下，耳朵里再次传来那两把争辩的声音……

9000975.en: Reckless creature. Could you do anything other than killing?
9000975.ch: 莽夫，你除去杀戮，还会做什么？

9000976.en: Then what are you? I'll smash you to ashes, and scatter them altogether!
9000976.ch: 破玩意，我要将你剁碎、剁烂、剁成粉末！然后扬了，扬了！！！

9000979.en: My friend, please return. There are powerful barriers set upon the wall, preventing anyone from getting close to them. If you want to join our battle, please visit the Monster Resisting Altar in the Cultivator Alliance, and then come to Wave of Monsters Battlefield on the other side of the wall from there.
9000979.ch: 道友，留步。城墙上布有强力结界，无法靠近。还请你到仙盟御妖台再离开仙盟去到城墙外兽潮战场参战。

9000980.en: My friend, the Wave of Monsters has struck again, and Master sent me to ask you to help us defend the wall.
9000980.ch: 道友好，兽潮突然来袭，盟主命我通知，请你协同守护城墙。

9000981.en: The Elders coordinate well. They attack and defend stably and flawlessly, but the Master issues many hasty attacks as if trying to kill Jiuying as soon as possible. At the same time, Jiuying only spits true fire toward the Master, and the Elders are fighting with her partial power.
9000981.ch: 几名长老通力合作，攻守都十分严谨。盟主则屡发攻势，似乎急于击杀九婴。另一边九婴亦连喷真火攻击盟主，却只以余力应对几名长老。

9000982.en: The warriors of the Master soon force the monsters back. Suddenly, Jiuying lets out a roar, and purple-black flows gush out from around her, forming an overwhelming dark wave. It left many Alliance Disciples severely wounded, and Jiuying took this chance and escaped.
9000982.ch: 盟主一方很快将对手逼得连连倒退。此时九婴突发一声啸鸣，身周紫黑色气流无故散聚，形成黑浪波及四方。无数仙盟弟子均被重伤，而九婴发此重击后亦急速遁去。

9000983.en: Now you see those warriors return from outside the wall. The Master coughs out some blood and stands up again, his face dark and grey. Even Luo Ying and other Elders are heavily wounded. They are knocked down to the ground, and are supported by some elite guards.
9000983.ch: 此时围攻九婴的主力都先后回到城墙内。盟主咳了几口血，铁青着脸重新站起。骆瑛等几名长老则重伤倒地，由几名近卫扶持。

9000984.en: (Coughs) What a sly enemy! The monster intends to bring us down with it by channeling Nether Air to here! Jiuying is wounded today, and other monsters are easy to be dealt with. Go back to the Alliance to treat the wounds, you all! I'll stay here for further defense.
9000984.ch: 咳咳！好狡猾的妖兽，竟引动冥气打算同归于尽！九婴今日也受了伤，余下妖兽不足道哉。大家先回仙盟养伤，此处有我坐镇。

9000985.en: I find Jiuying's behavior pattern odd. Each time she seemed to be luring Master out so that she could kill him.
9000985.ch: 在下总觉得这九婴妖兽非同一般，乃是一次次引诱盟主亲自出战，好伺机击杀。

9000986.en: I think it was Master who was luring Jiuying out. It seems to me that Master's real purpose is to kill Jiuying, not to stop the Wave of Monsters.
9000986.ch: 我倒觉得是盟主每次都在引诱九婴出手。我总觉得盟主其实只要杀九婴，而不是要抵挡兽潮。

9000987.en: I think you're being foolish. It's Jiuying who commands the Wave of Monsters to attack the Alliance, so we must kill Jiuying first to turn the tide of war. How can you say Master doesn't want to stop the Wave of Monsters?
9000987.ch: 你这是浑话了。九婴调度兽潮，屡次冲击仙盟。我们要打开局面，非杀死九婴不可。什么叫盟主不是要抵挡兽潮？

9000988.en: Listen. As long as Xingtian at the Ancient Gate is still alive, the monsters are still under his control to form into the Wave of Monsters. Killing Jiuying will only make it less threatening, but they will still keep coming. The only way to end this threat once and for all is to go further inland and kill Xingtian!
9000988.ch: 你听哥哥说，只要太古玄门的刑天还在，妖兽就还会受此巨人操控，形成兽潮。击杀九婴，不过让来临的兽潮易于应对。设法深入内陆击杀刑天才是道理啊！

9000989.en: Their debate continues as they walk away.
9000989.ch: 二人边走边说，渐去渐远。

9000990.en: You killed the ferocious beast Chaos shortly after joining our Alliance, and now you have made great contributions to the war against the Wave of Monsters. No wonder you have won Master's favor.
9000990.ch: 道友来我仙盟后先破凶兽，后又在兽潮之战中屡屡显出神勇，果然就得到盟主重用。

9000991.en: Jiuying has always been a big threat to our Alliance. Of course we must get rid of her. But we shouldn't rush things.
9000991.ch: 九婴向来是我仙盟心腹大患，当然要设法除去。但也不能操之过急。

9000992.en: You are a treasure to our Alliance. You should be more careful about your own safety, especially in crises. Don't let your passion blind your eyes.
9000992.ch: 道友乃是有用之身，该退时还是稍稍退步为好。特别是在危机之中，万勿只逞血勇。

9000993.en: Oh, please forgive me for being so garrulous. I'm sure you will figure it out.
9000993.ch: 唉，老身说了多余的话，请道友好生斟酌。

9000994.en: What went wrong? Why is this monster still alive... Oh, I was lost in thought and didn't see you.
9000994.ch: 究竟是哪里出问题，怎么还是没能杀死这妖孽……啊，本座想事想得入神了，倒没发现道友来了。

9000995.en: I suppose it's all fate. You have risked your life to distract the monsters, and we have gathered the best cultivators in the Alliance to surround it, but we still failed and got wounded.
9000995.ch: 也是我仙盟应有此劫，道友舍命引开妖兽，我们也聚起仙盟最厉害的高手围困妖兽，竟也损兵折将，功亏一篑。

9000996.en: You've fought a tough battle today. Just take the pills to stabilize your energy. What a shame...
9000996.ch: 道友，今日大战一场，且服几枚理由气丸稳住气息。可惜，可惜……

9000997.en: We can only get near Xingtian after killing Jiuying. I gave you three months to come up with a plan to kill Jiuying, and this is your result?
9000997.ch: 一切都只有在击杀九婴之后才能接触刑天，我给你三月时间思索击杀九婴的法子，到头来你就给我这个？

9000999.en: Then why are you still wasting time on the ground? Go and think how we can kill Jiuying!
9000999.ch: 还跪着干嘛？赶紧继续去找法子杀死九婴啊！

9001001.en: Jiuying... Jiuying... Why did she survive every time...
9001001.ch: 九婴……九婴……怎么就杀不死呢……

9001002.en: There are often noises in the Alliance recently, and sometimes with shakings from Taoist clashes.
9001002.ch: 近日仙盟之中时常发出喧哗之声，偶尔还出现道法交锋的剧震。

9001003.en: *sigh* Elder Luo must feel troubled lately.
9001003.ch: 唉，最近骆姑姑一定很烦恼了。

9001004.en: Ever since Master Xiang was killed by Jiuying, the position of Alliance Master has been vacant. The senior members of the Alliance believed we must have a new master to lead the Alliance, so they started to discuss possible candidates.
9001004.ch: 自从向盟主被九婴击杀，盟主之位空缺。盟中要员以为我们不能群龙无首，便开始商议盟主继任之事。

9001005.en: At first, the discussion was peaceful. But later on, conflicts arose, and some members even turned to brutal force. Aunt Luo went to great lengths to calm them down.
9001005.ch: 这开始的时候，大家还是好好说话的。但后来一言不合，竟然动起手来争夺大位。骆姑姑好说歹说，这才压住众人。

9001006.en: In fact, Aunt Luo is the best candidate to be the new Alliance Master with her seniority and contribution, but she just won't take the position. Could you go and persuade her to take it?
9001006.ch: 其实以骆姑姑功劳资历，最适合出任这盟主之职，但她却一直推辞。不如你去劝劝她吧，好不好？

9001007.en: Aunt Luo is in the Wenji Mansion now! Go talk to her now!
9001007.ch: 姑姑目前正在问机别馆呢！你快去跟她说说去！

9001008.en: *sigh* We are still in the middle of the huge crisis, and now we are fighting among ourselves.
9001008.ch: 唉，眼前的大难题还没解决，咱们就为了这盟主之位自己乱起来。

9001009.en: I'm always a kid in her eyes, and she won't listen to me! How about you go talk to her?
9001009.ch: 她老将我当小孩，我说什么她都不听我的！不如还是由你去跟她说说吧？

9001010.en: You're here, my friend. I should have paid you a visit to thank you for saving me, but I have been too busy lately and couldn't make the time. *sigh* This is such a tricky matter.
9001010.ch: 是道友来了。原本老身该为上次道友相救之事登门道谢的，只因近日琐事缠身，以致迟迟未能成行。唉……这仙盟之事，真叫人烦恼。

9001011.en: You may find it amusing to see our members fighting for the position of Alliance Master. Our Alliance has always been proud of our solidarity.
9001011.ch: 说来好笑。我仙盟一向团结，未料这姓向的一去，大家竟为这盟主之位争得面红耳赤。

9001013.en: You made a good point. As long as the position remains vacant, it will stir infighting among our members. I have an idea to solve the problem.
9001013.ch: 道友所言甚是。这盟主之位一日悬空，众要员便会互相争夺。为此老身已想了一法，压住众人争端。

9001014.en: I will propose that whoever finds the artifact Sharp Awl for the Alliance will be the new Alliance Master. It was lost a long time ago and has never been heard of since. If no one can find it, it doesn't matter. It will give me more time to pick a suitable candidate.
9001014.ch: 老身提议只需寻回仙盟一枚法宝利锥，便可当上这盟主之位。此枚锥子失落已久，杳无音讯。他们遍寻不着，老身正好趁这段时间物色人选。

9001015.en: But on the other hand, Sharp Awl is an extremely powerful artifact. Retrieving it for the Alliance will be a great contribution, and whoever finds it merits the position of the Alliance Master.
9001015.ch: 不过话又说回来，法宝利锥是件利器，锥茫一发，可伤仙神。取回此物，于我仙盟功劳极大，由此人担任盟主倒也未尝不可。

9001016.en: *sigh* If I could have come up with a better idea, I wouldn't be troubled by this matter.
9001016.ch: 唉，老身真有什么妙计也不至于眼前为了这盟主之事一筹莫展了。

9001017.en: What? Aunt Luo is still reluctant to be the new Alliance Master?
9001017.ch: 啊？姑姑还是不愿意当这仙盟之主么？

9001018.en: So Aunt Luo came up with such a proposal? I know that awl. So if I can find it, I will be the Alliance Master! Heehee!
9001018.ch: 原来姑姑许下这样的条件啊？那枚锥子我知道。要么我去将锥子取来，由我来当盟主好了！嘿嘿！

9001019.en: Once upon a time, a powerful monster appeared behind the Alliance territory and was regarded as a big threat to the Alliance.
9001019.ch: 昔日仙盟后方出现一只实力极强的妖兽。当时我仙盟视这盘踞后方的妖物为心腹大患。

9001020.en: It was the golden age of the Alliance then. Sharp Awl was crafted as a weapon against Xingtian at the Ancient Gate.
9001020.ch: 那是仙盟最为强盛的时候，他们为对付太古玄门刑天群策群力制成利锥一枚；

9001021.en: A powerful Elder fought with the monster for over a month, and finally the Elder had no choice but to seal off the monster underground with Sharp Awl.
9001021.ch: 当时一名实力超凡的长老与妖兽连续激战一个月之久，这位长老无可奈何，凭借利锥将此妖钉在地底以封印此妖。

9001022.en: That Elder was elected Alliance Master for the great feat, and the Alliance survived that crisis and was able to turn their attention to the Wave of Monsters.
9001022.ch: 这位长老封印妖兽，成为盟主。仙盟因此度过一劫，这才回过头来抵御兽潮。

9001023.en: That awl has been lost since then. I'm surprise Aunt Luo still remembers it.
9001023.ch: 这枚锥子失落已久，真亏姑姑还记得。

9001025.en: It turns out one of my father's wishes was to craft another Sharp Awl to fight Xingtian... But it was too difficult to craft, and father failed in the end.
9001025.ch: 原来爹爹昔日其中一个愿望便是重铸此锥以克制刑天……可惜这枚锥子十分难制，最终爹爹还是没能将此锥炼成。

9001026.en: But he had plans to retrieve the lost artifact Sharp Awl. I found many clues in father's writings, but I'm not strong enough to activate my Mind Sea to inspect the surroundings...
9001026.ch: 不过爹爹曾打算寻回失落的法宝锥子。我翻开爹爹遗作，发现诸多线索。只是我修为未足，还不能启动识海视察附近东西……

9001027.en: So... I wonder if we could go together. You can activate your Mind Sea to locate it so that I can retrieve it!
9001027.ch: 所以……咱们能不能一起去。你去启动识海察知确切地点，我去找出锥子！

9001028.en: Yuan'er, Elder Luo is free now and wants to teach you a Mind Skill in the Wenji Mansion. You have always been waiting for this day, right?
9001028.ch: 鸢儿，骆长老现在得空，她让你去问机别馆一趟，好面授心法。你终于盼到了吧？

9001029.en: Eh... Please keep this for me... I can't let Aunt Luo know I'm going to look for the awl...
9001029.ch: 呃……这个给你……要是让姑姑知道我想去找出锥子那可不得了……

9001030.en: Luo Ying's bodyguard takes Yuan'er away after she hands over the page to you...
9001030.ch: 骆瑛近卫奚照将鸢儿带走，而她临走之前，将一页心得交到你手……

9001031.en: Gu Yuan'er has figured out the approximate location of the awl and sketched a map on the page.
9001031.ch: 顾鸢儿已推知利锥的大概位置，而且在书页上画出相关地理。

9001032.en: Gu Yuan'er has figured out the approximate location of the awl. You only need to go there and locate the artifact with your Mind Sea. (Cast Geomancy nearby)
9001032.ch: 顾鸢儿已经推知了法宝的大约位置，只需要前往该地，凭借识海察知法宝确切所在。（去到附近位置堪舆）

9001034.en: You pull it out, and to your surprise, the monster stands up again with a shake and starts to speak...
9001034.ch: 你拔出锥子，妖兽抖动一下竟然重新站起。同时，一个声音在洞穴中徐徐响起……

9001035.en: Ha... A human... You will make a good dish to restore my lost essence, and then I'll eliminate that so-called Alliance... *sinister sneer*
9001035.ch: 呵……是一个人族……吃了你稍微补充一下我损失的真元后，我便要将那个所谓的仙盟杀个鸡犬不留……桀桀桀……

9001039.en: Your ambition impressed me. I made the promise, and I will keep it. You will be the new Alliance Master.
9001039.ch: 道友既有雄心，老身又曾许下重诺，这盟主之位当然由道友接任了。

9001040.en: You retrieved the awl for the Alliance and made one more great contribution. No one else in the Alliance can rival you in terms of contribution now. Surely you should be our new Alliance Master, not me.
9001040.ch: 道友取回锥子，又为仙盟立下一功。今日仙盟之中，功绩之高，数道友为最。这盟主之位理当由道友接任。哪有老身来担任盟主的道理呢？

9001041.en: Our Alliance is in a dire situation, and it's only right for the most capable person to lead it. I have made the promise to everyone in the Alliance that whoever retrieves the artifact will be the new Alliance Master.
9001041.ch: 仙盟常处艰难，盟主大位向来为有能者居之。而且骆瑛已向仙盟许下重诺，谁能取回法宝，即是仙盟之主。

9001042.en: You have done so much for the Alliance, and now you have found the lost artifact and put an end to the conflict. It's fate that chose you to be our Alliance Master, for your competence and your virtue. Please take this position and be our new Master!
9001042.ch: 再者，道友屡为仙盟出力，是有功。法宝失落已久，道友终于寻得，是有缘。结束众人为盟主之位的争端，是有德。因此还请道友，不，盟主即位，不要再辞让了！

9001043.en: After you take the position of the Alliance Master, you lead the Alliance to repel the Wave of Monsters twice and empty a large area of land beyond the wall.
9001043.ch: 你接任盟主之后，亲自主持击退两次兽潮。将仙盟外数千里地重新肃清。

9001044.en: Without Jiuying at their command, the Wave of Monsters has waned, so you move the Alliance forward to the old line of defense on the advice of Luo Ying with her help.
9001044.ch: 骆瑛眼看兽潮失去九婴主持，实力大减，便助你将仙盟重新迁移到旧日防线。

9001046.en: *sigh* Please take some more time to consider it...
9001046.ch: 唉，还请道友再细细考虑……

9001047.en: I implore you not to refuse it.
9001047.ch: 老身恳请道友勿再推辞。

9001048.en: Hmph, it should have been me to be the new Alliance Master! You are lucky! If you are fed up with the job one day, remember to give it to me! Okay? Heehee!
9001048.ch: 哼，本来该由我来当盟主的！现在算是便宜你啦！以后当烦了记得将盟主之位让给我！知道嘛？嘻嘻！

9001049.en: Since you became the new Alliance Master, you have spent much less time adventuring with me! What a pity! It's all Aunt Luo's fault!
9001049.ch: 你当盟主以后就没时间和我混了！想想都有点可惜！都怪姑姑！

9001050.en: *sigh* My good Master, you were too involved to see through it. Aunt Luo has always been eager to make you our new Alliance Master.
9001050.ch: 唉，盟主大人，你这就叫当局者迷。其实姑姑一直有心让你当盟主的。

9001051.en: She knew you were strong enough to defeat the sealed monster and you had my help to locate it! My father went to great lengths to look for this artifact, and he must have left many clues in his writings, which would be available to you through me.
9001051.ch: 她啊，知道你有击败封印妖兽的实力。而且你有我！我爹爹曾付出很多心血找这件法宝。而我获得爹爹遗作，一定能从里面找到蛛丝马迹，查得法宝位置。

9001052.en: Aunt Luo loves me, but she doesn't have time to adventure with me. She knew I would help you find the artifact. With the old Master's artifact and one more feat, it would only be natural for you to be our new Master.
9001052.ch: 姑姑虽然疼爱我，却不会陪我胡闹。她料定我会找你去完成这件事。你取得了昔日盟主的法宝，再次为仙盟立下大功，成为盟主就顺理成章了。

9001053.en: Oh, I took too much of your time. You're a bigwig now, so you must be very busy. But don't forget to adventure with me when you can make the time! We can travel all over Chi You and find all the hidden secrets!
9001053.ch: 唉！不说了，你现在是大人物，一定很多事情要忙。不过你如果有空了，也要陪我玩呀！到时我们去探遍赤幽州每一寸地方，把这里面的隐秘都挖出来！

9001054.en: Luo Ying is sitting in a pavilion and looking into the distance. She frowns and looks troubled by something important.
9001054.ch: 骆瑛正坐一座亭阁中眺望远方，她双眉紧蹙，眼神之中带了几分愁绪，似乎正在思量什么要事。

9001056.en: Since you joined us, we Cultivator Alliance has reclaimed the Heaven Sacrifice Altar, invited Sunny, defeated Jiuying, and restored the old abbey of the alliance. What more could be troubling me?
9001056.ch: 仙盟自打盟主加入，先收回祈天台请来圣阳，后又击败九婴，恢复仙盟旧观，我还能有什么烦恼呢？

9001057.en: But the seniors of the alliance came to Chi You to repel the Wave of Monster, investigate the source of the Nether Air, and eliminate Xingtian, the greatest threat. Now is the time for us to continue with their cause.
9001057.ch: 不过，昔日仙盟先辈来到赤幽州乃是为了抵挡兽潮，彻底查探冥气源头解决刑天的大患。现在也是时候继续进行这件大事了。

9001058.en: According to the writings left by the seniors, there is a sky-high big tree southwest of Chi You. It is a Mystic Realm only alliance masters can enter.
9001058.ch: 依仙盟先辈记载，于赤幽州西南角有一冲天大树。那边原是历代盟主才能进入的秘境。

9001059.en: The late Master Xiang once explored it with Yuan'er's father. They came back alive, and it seemed they met some mysteries there.
9001059.ch: 已故的向盟主曾与鸢儿父亲二人深入大树所在之处进行查探。二人后来都回来了，那边似乎有什么玄机。

9001060.en: According to Nangang, they were trapped by a tree array once they got near the big tree. Nangang struggled to hold it back to allow Master Xiang to go nearer the tree. He didn't know the mysteries of the tree, but it was obvious that the area around it was full of Qi without much Nether Air.
9001060.ch: 据南罡所说，当日他们去到大树附近即为树阵所困。南罡勉力与树阵对抗，让向盟主进入大树范围内。他并不知道大树里的玄机，但大树周围灵气充斥，冥气稀薄，却是显而易见。

9001062.en: Master Xiang said the core area near the big tree was too dangerous for him to enter, but I thought he was lying. After he returned with Nangang, he was much stronger than before. I think he must have had an adventure there.
9001062.ch: 向盟主所说，大树周围凶险重重，无法通过。我看他这话有点不尽不实，而他与南罡前往大树回来后，修为明显高出往昔一截，我以为他在那处有过一段奇遇。

9001063.en: This place is the base of the Cultivator Alliance, and beyond the walls it's infested with monsters. But we can build a branch of our alliance in Tree Vault as a camp for our further exploration, so we must explore Tree Vault first. It's an arduous task, and only a battlewise cultivator has a chance to succeed.
9001063.ch: 此处是仙盟根本所在，离开城墙，难免受妖物侵扰。但我们可以在建木之处建立仙盟分部，以此中继，再往深处查探。查探建木势在必行。只是前途艰险，必须由修为深湛善于杀敌的修仙者才能胜任。

9001064.en: According to the rules set by the seniors in the alliance, only alliance masters can enter that area. It's not our place to challenge the rules, but this crisis demands urgent action. Please go there and take a look before we move over.
9001064.ch: 而我仙盟前辈已有约定，那片地方也只有仙盟盟主才能进入。原本仙盟定下的规矩我们身为晚辈不应随意变改，但眼前事急从权，因此希望盟主先前往一探。

9001065.en: If it's safe enough, I hope we can build an alliance branch there to serve our further exploration of Chi You.
9001065.ch: 若无危险，属下希望即刻在那边建立仙盟分部，好进一步深入赤幽州。

9001066.en: You arrive at the place mentioned by Luo Ying. There stands a sky-high, majestic tree. Just as you are about to move forward, vines stretch out from under the earth to entangle you.
9001066.ch: 你来到骆瑛所说地点附近，前方面前大树参天，十分宏伟，正打算继续前行，地上突然冒出大量藤蔓将你缠住。

9001067.en: You snap off some vines, but more appear to replace them.
9001067.ch: 你扯断两根藤蔓，地上又马上长出树根将你缠住。

9001069.en: This is a human cultivator, I don't want to talk nonsense with you, take your life...
9001069.ch: 竟是个人族修士，本座不想与你废话，拿命来吧……

9001070.en: Vines keep sprouting out of the earth, bringing forth horrible spikes at you. Gu Yuan'er struggles to get rid of the tentacles, but only in vain in face of their quick replacements.
9001070.ch: 地上不断冒出藤蔓，附近还不断长出可怕的尖木，朝你这边慢慢刺来。顾鸢儿勉力挣脱束缚，但又被地上生成的新藤卷住。

9001071.en: Arrrgh... My hands... I can't breathe...
9001071.ch: 啊啊啊啊……我的手……脖子透不过气了……

9001072.en: The giant tree in front of you has intertwined roots where Energy surges. It seems to be an array.
9001072.ch: 你面前大树气根纠缠，聚成虬结，中间灵力涌动，看似是什么法阵。

9001074.en: *cough* You're not too bad. Seems I have to get serious.
9001074.ch: 咳咳……你实力不差，看来本座得稍微多用几分本事了。

9001075.en: He's the one who helped Hou Yi shoot the suns in Yong Ning.
9001075.ch: 他便是我之前跟你提过的，在永宁州协助后羿射日之人。

9001076.en: In that case, I'll give you a chance to explain why you've trespassed my place.
9001076.ch: 既然如此，本座便给你机会，解释一下为何擅闯此地？

9001077.en: Of course I support you to kill Xingtian, but I can't help with that, since Tree Vault can only curb the Nether Air. You may as well turn back.
9001077.ch: 你欲杀刑天，本座自然支持，但建木只能遏止冥气，我这里并无击杀刑天之法，你还是回去吧。

9001078.en: That's right, you'd better go and look for another way.
9001078.ch: 不错，你还是再去寻其他方法吧。

9001079.en: Are you OK? Is that tree in danger? I came here as soon as the vines loosened. You're not going to look in there? I heard Aunt Luo say only alliance masters were allowed there, so why are you going back?
9001079.ch: 你没事吧？那棵大树有危险么？藤蔓一松开我就过来了。那边不查探了么？我听到了啊，骆姑姑说这边只有盟主才能来查探的，怎么就往回走了呢？

9001080.en: Well... I'm just worried about you!

9001081.en: I see. I could've never imagined there is a Muzheng Goumang living in this remote wilderness. So we'll never know what Nangang and the previous alliance master met in there. Well then, we can only try again to find another solution to the crisis in Chi You.
9001081.ch: 原来如此，不想赤幽州这荒僻之野还住着一位木正句芒。看来当年南罡与前盟主在那边经历了什么是无从得知了。无妨，那我们再另寻他法解决眼前赤幽州的问题吧。

9001082.en: While Goumang is about to attack again, a girl in green suddenly appears and stops him.
9001082.ch: 就在句芒欲再度出手之际，一个绿衣女孩突然出现拦住了他。

9001083.en: Stop! Goumang, don't you care about your own safety?!
9001083.ch: 住手，句芒，你真的不在乎自己的安危了吗！

9001084.en: As Bihong stands in front of him, Goumang has to withdraw. Bihong looks at you with an unexpected look on her face.
9001084.ch: 句芒看着碧泓站在身前，不得不收手，随后碧泓方才看向你，脸上露出了意外的神色。

9001085.en: It's you. What are you doing here...?

9001087.en: Master, it's not good! The guards on the walls reported a gust of Nether Air in the depths of Chi You. It has permeated the sky and blocked sunshine! Aunt Luo asked you to go to the walls to discuss the matter!
9001087.ch: 盟主，出大事了！据驻守城墙的弟子禀报，赤幽州深处不知为何突然冒起大股冥气遮住了天空，姑姑请你速到城墙之上商量！

9001089.en: You see gusts of Nether Air surging upward in the distance, dyeing the sky in purple black.
9001089.ch: 你在城墙之上，果然看见远处冥气果然从地上升起直冲天际，放眼所及，天空尽成紫黑之色。

9001090.en: Master, according to the guards, a large amount of Nether Air appeared in the distance an hour ago. The monsters were invigorated by Nether Air and formed a Wave of Monsters to charge at our walls.
9001090.ch: 盟主，据仙卫禀报，半个时辰前，远处无故冒出大量冥气。这冥气之势一起，妖兽变得凶猛异常，还聚成兽潮冲击城墙。

9001092.en: Some disciples in Nether Air are attacked by the monsters!
9001092.ch: 冥气之中还有仙盟弟子，正遭到妖兽攻击！

9001093.en: Master, let me go to rescue them!
9001093.ch: 盟主，便由我前去将在外的仙盟弟子救回！

9001095.en: OK, Yuan'er, go with me. Master, people would feel unsafe as the Nether Air spreads. We need you to return to the wall to comfort them.
9001095.ch: 也好，鸢儿你便随我一同前去。盟主，如今冥气扩散，人心浮动，需要您先返回城墙处稳定人心。

9001096.ch: 不好了，盟主，骆姑姑她受了重伤！

9001097.en: The Nether Air was extremely ferocious in where the disciples were besieged. Aunt rescued some disciples, but she herself...
9001097.ch: 仙盟弟子被围攻之处，冥气异常凶猛，虽说姑姑救回数人，但自己也……

9001098.en: Luo Ying sits cross-legged on the ground, with her forehead covered with sweat. Beside her, Feng Yunchuo is bowing his head in thought.
9001098.ch: 骆瑛正盘坐地上，脸色十分难看，额头更是布满汗水，而在她一旁，风允婼则正低头沉思。

9001099.en: Elder Luo is heavily wounded, but she won't lose her life.
9001099.ch: 骆长老伤势虽重，性命却是无碍。

9001100.en: Had it not been for Chief Feng, I would be dead in the Nether Air.
9001100.ch: 此番若非风族长冒险营救，老身恐怕也得失落于冥气之中。

9001101.en: It is really abnormal that the Nether Air has suddenly become thicker now. We might avoid confronting the Nether Air and the monsters first, recharge our energy, and then deal with them gradually.
9001101.ch: 风某认为，如今冥气骤然变浓，实在非正常之事，不妨先避开冥气与妖兽的锋芒，养精蓄锐，再与妖兽周旋不迟。

9001102.en: *cough* I agree. But it still bothers me to know that many alliance disciples are still trapped in there.
9001102.ch: 咳咳……老身也认为是这个道理……只是还有仙盟弟子身陷在外，却好叫老身不安。

9001103.en: Never mind. I know that place. I'll go there to rescue the guards.
9001103.ch: 无妨，风某知道那个地方，这就去将他们救回。

9001104.en: No! The Nether Air there is too dense! You're wounded too. You should not risk your life! I'll go...
9001104.ch: 万万不可！那边冥气太过厚重，风族长身负重伤，岂能再去冒险？还是老身前去……

9001105.en: Both of you are seriously injured. Take a rest. I will go to rescue the disciples.
9001105.ch: 骆长老和风族长皆受重伤，你们还是在此安心疗养，我去将仙盟弟子救回。

9001106.en: Luo Ying tells you the position of the alliance guards who are trapped deep inside the Nether Air. They are exposed to lethal danger. Rescue the guards as soon as possible.
9001106.ch: 骆瑛将失陷在冥气深处的仙卫地点告知于你，待在那边的仙卫每时每刻都处在危险之中，要尽快将之救回。

9001107.en: *sigh* It really pains me to stay here and do nothing. Only if I were younger.
9001107.ch: 唉……真叫人着急。只可惜这把老骨头耐不住折腾。

9001108.en: The monster in the depths of the Nether Air is very strong. Since we are all wounded, we should not act rashly, and the alliance guards are all veterans and should be able to withstand it for a little longer. We just can't afford to lose our composure and discretion.
9001108.ch: 那只在冥气深处的妖兽十分强大，我们眼下都身负创伤，不宜冒险。仙卫久经磨练，应该能够抵御一阵。我们不可自乱阵脚。

9001109.en: It's not a severe wound. This sudden burst of Nether Air must be a result of Xingtian waving his war axe...
9001109.ch: 这点轻伤算不上什么。冥气无故爆发，看似与刑天舞动战斧有关……

9001110.en: *sigh* It's such a dilemma. I'm really worried.
9001110.ch: 唉……此事进退两难，实在好叫人着急。

9001111.en: The Nether Air ahead is so dense that you feel dizzy once you get inside. Just at that time, you hear a noise from somewhere near...
9001111.ch: 前方冥气果然十分浓厚，一经踏入立即感到不适，就在这时，远方传来了巨大声响……

9001112.en: Three disciples are seen attacked by a huge monster, and they are retreating.
9001112.ch: 循声看去，三位仙盟弟子正被一只巨大的妖兽所攻击，节节败退。

9001113.en: Your attack has sent the monster into collapse, but it somehow stands up within an instant. It gives off Nether Air all over its body, making its fearsome look even more ferocious.
9001113.ch: 妖兽遭到你攻击后已萎靡不振，但不知为何，眨眼间便又站起，只见它浑身冒出冥气，本已十分狰狞的外貌更显凶猛。

9001114.en: Oh, no! This monster has absorbed lots of Nether Air and is going berserk!
9001114.ch: 糟糕，此妖吸收了大量冥气，要狂暴了！

9001115.en: Master, go! Or it will be too late!
9001115.ch: 盟主，你快走，再晚便来不及了！

9001116.en: Hmph, the monsters transformed by Nether Air really are powerful.
9001116.ch: 哼，冥气改造过的妖兽果然厉害。

9001117.en: Goumang suddenly appears in mid-air. He waves his sleeve, and a spike teemed with Qi falls from the sky and pins Taotie to the ground. It is killed, and the permeating Nether Air gradually begins to lift.
9001117.ch: 半空中，句芒突然现身，他袖子一扬，一根充满灵气的尖木当空刺落，将狂暴的妖兽钉死在地上，随后冲天的冥气也逐渐散去……

9001118.en: So, you are the Alliance Master. That is beyond my expectation. Since you are more trustworthy than Xiang Lingjun, I would talk to you about something.
9001118.ch: 原来你是这仙盟之主，倒出乎本座意料，看你比向令钧可信，那有些事便可与你一谈。

9001119.en: You arrive at the agreed place to see Goumang holdings his hands behind his back and looking beyond the Ancient Gate, absorbed in thought.
9001119.ch: 你来到约定的地点，看到句芒正远望太古玄门深处，神情显得十分凝重。

9001120.en: Although I have just killed the monster, it would not help Chi You a lot. On the contrary, the whole thing is getting more serious.
9001120.ch: 虽说本座刚杀了那狂暴的凶兽，但于赤幽州局势并无太大影响，相反，整个形势更加严峻。

9001121.en: Lately, I have sensed that Xingtian is on the verge of awakening...
9001121.ch: 本座近日已感觉到，这刑天恐怕已濒临苏醒……
